chapters.title: Chapter 1901: Top Four!
paragraphs: Ervin stood quietly in the middle of the curse field and raised his black spear.
"Abyssal Origin Descent."

The black sea rose behind him, and the broken gate appeared. Morgana’s curse mirrors did not shatter immediately. Instead, they began sinking. It was a strange and eerie sight. The mirrors trembled as if their curses were trying to cling to reality, while the abyss beneath Ervin dragged their foundations downward.

Morgana quickly used "Star-Curse Labyrinth, Nameless Witch Burial," attempting to trap Ervin before the gate opened wider, but Ervin answered with "Gate of the First Depth" and pierced through the burial curse with one spear.
The battle lasted longer than many expected, because Morgana constantly shifted her curses and never allowed Ervin to swallow the entire labyrinth at once.

But once Ervin used "Abyssal Origin Descent, Return To Depth," the strongest core of the Star-Curse Labyrinth sank into the black sea, and Morgana gave up before the abyssal pull could damage her foundation.
[Winner: Ervin.]
[Morgana Starveil Defeated.]
[Battle Record Updated.]
[Ervin]
[Total Battles Fought: 21]
[Total Wins: 21]
Ervin returned to his pillar in silence, while Morgana sighed softly after returning to hers.
"Every time I fight one of you monsters, I feel as though I should have chosen a gentler path," she muttered.
Rakan laughed from the side. "Like what?"
Morgana glanced at him. "Anything that does not involve being swallowed by black seas, cut by sword heavens, erased by void eyes, or punched by war lunatics."
Rakan grinned. "That sounds boring."
Morgana smiled faintly. "Of course you would think so."
The arena relaxed for a breath, but only for a breath. The next battle immediately pulled everyone back into tension.
[Damian Voss vs Rosaline Lunara]

Rosaline stepped onto the stage with the Dawn Sovereign Sanctuary rising behind her from the very beginning. Rose-gold palaces formed, petals filled the air, and sovereign seals descended as the entire sanctuary tried to restrict Damian’s sword before it left its sheath. She had learned from previous battles and refused to let Damian gather sword rhythm freely.
But Damian’s response was brutally clean. He opened Sword Sovereign Heaven without hesitation, not because he feared Rosaline, but because he had no reason to waste time so close to the end.

"Sword Sovereign Heaven, First Edict, All Blades Refuse Submission" shattered the first three Dawn Edicts, while "One Sword Divides Heaven" cut through the Royal Mandate of Purifying Light. Rosaline tried to condense everything into "Final Dawn Edict, Sovereign Rose Spear," but Damian’s sword light split the spear before it could reach him.
Rosaline surrendered with a helpless smile.
[Winner: Damian Voss.]
[Rosaline Lunara Defeated.]
[Battle Record Updated.]
[Damian Voss]
[Total Battles Fought: 21]
[Total Wins: 21]

The projection above the arena flashed again and again as the records of the remaining top geniuses began aligning. Max Morgan, Ervin, Revona, and Damian Voss all rose to the top. All four were still undefeated, and all four now held twenty-one victories.

The Divine Realm noticed the pattern before Angelina even spoke, and a heavy silence began spreading from one viewing platform to another. Every elder, disciple, clan leader, sect master, and hidden expert understood what it meant. The real climax had finally arrived.

Angelina Valerius floated above the central stage with her silver-white robe stirring gently around her. The laws of the Eternal Hourglass gathered behind her like golden streams, and for the first time in a long while, she did not immediately call the next random battle. Instead, she raised one hand, and the entire screen above the arena changed.
Four names appeared.
[Max Morgan]
[Ervin]
[Revona]
[Damian Voss]
Beside each name, the same record appeared.
[Total Battles Fought: 21]
[Total Wins: 21]
The whole arena fell silent.
Angelina’s calm voice spread through the Eternal Hourglass and reached every viewing screen across the Divine Realm.
"The Cosmic Ascension Conference has now entered the final stretch of the final competitive stage."
Her words made the atmosphere grow even heavier.
"Among all remaining participants, only four have preserved a perfect record until this point."
The four names shone brighter.
"Max Morgan."
"Ervin."
"Revona."
"Damian Voss."

The moment she spoke their names, countless eyes turned toward the four pillars. Max stood calmly with his white hair drifting faintly and Dragonheart resting at his waist. Ervin stood with his black spear in hand, silent and abyss-like. Revona sat quietly, her Void Origin Eyes calm and unfathomable. Damian Voss stood with his sword sheathed, his expression as still as a blade hidden beneath snow.
Angelina continued.
"All four of them have achieved twenty-one victories without a single defeat."
The screen enlarged the records once more.
[Max Morgan: 21 Victories, 0 Defeats]
[Ervin: 21 Victories, 0 Defeats]
[Revona: 21 Victories, 0 Defeats]
[Damian Voss: 21 Victories, 0 Defeats]
A storm of excitement began rising across the Divine Realm. Angelina’s voice remained calm and clear.
"From this point onward, their remaining battles against one another will decide the final champion of the Cosmic Ascension Conference."
The arena shook with whispers.
Max against Ervin.
Max against Revona.
Max against Damian.
Ervin against Revona.
Ervin against Damian.
Revona against Damian.
Every possible pairing among them was enough to be called a peak battle.
Angelina looked at the four of them. "All four will battle each other. Whoever remains undefeated after these final battles will become the winner of this Cosmic Ascension Conference."

The moment those words fell, the Divine Realm erupted. The Black Dragon Clan disciples shouted Max’s name with wild excitement. The Sword God Palace disciples gripped their swords with burning eyes. The hidden forces watching Ervin fell silent and tense, while countless spectators stared at Revona with deep awe. Even the defeated top geniuses on the pillars looked serious.
Rakan Thorne grinned. "Now this is what I was waiting for."
Orion Starfall leaned back with a tired smile. "The monster round."
Morgana Starveil chuckled softly. "The rest of us were only sharpening stones, it seems."
Kaiden Voidmere looked toward the four names. "No. We were all part of the same stage. They simply reached the last door without falling."
Aurelian Lareth remained silent. His gaze moved briefly toward Max, and then away again.
Above the central arena, the four undefeated names continued shining. Max Morgan, Ervin, Revona, and Damian Voss. The final battles had arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 1902: First Battle Between Top 4
paragraphs: The four names remained suspended above the Eternal Hourglass like four suns that refused to fall.
[Max Morgan]
[Ervin]
[Revona]
[Damian Voss]
[Total Battles Fought: 21]
[Total Wins: 21]

No one spoke for several breaths after Angelina Valerius finished explaining the final rule, because the weight of those words had already settled into the heart of every spectator across the Divine Realm.

All four of them had reached this point without a single defeat. All four had crushed, cut, erased, swallowed, or overwhelmed one terrifying opponent after another. Now the conference no longer needed lesser battles to shape the rankings.
The final answer would come from the four monsters fighting each other directly.
Above the central stage, Angelina slowly raised one hand.
"The first battle among the four undefeated participants will now be selected."

The moment she spoke, the entire Eternal Hourglass seemed to tighten. The giant screen above the arena changed. The names of every other participant faded away, leaving only four shining names rotating around one another in a circular formation.

Golden laws flowed around the screen to ensure that the selection could not be influenced by any outside power. Not even the hidden elders watching from the ancient forces could interfere with the randomizer controlled by the Eternal Hourglass.
[Max Morgan]
[Ervin]
[Revona]
[Damian Voss]
The four names spun faster and faster. The sound of the crowd slowly faded away, and even the defeated top geniuses on the pillars stopped talking.
Rakan Thorne crossed his arms, his eyes burning with excitement. "Here it comes."

Orion Starfall leaned forward slightly despite the lingering exhaustion in his body. His usual smile had returned, but there was no playfulness in his eyes this time. "No matter which two appear first, it will be insane."

Morgana Starveil tilted her head, her purple eyes reflecting the rotating names above. "Max against Damian would shake the Sword God Palace and the Black Dragon Clan at once. Max against Ervin would be a rematch with unfinished meaning. Ervin against Revona would be abyss against void. Damian against Revona would be sword judgment against origin erasure."
Kaiden Voidmere looked at the screen quietly. "Every combination is dangerous."
Aurelian Lareth remained silent, yet even he could not look away.

On one pillar, Damian Voss stood like an unsheathed sword waiting inside its scabbard. His expression did not change, yet anyone who understood swords could feel that his sword intent had grown sharper.
Sword Sovereign Heaven had already cut through too many powerful paths, but even Damian could not treat the remaining three lightly.

On another pillar, Ervin stood with his black spear in hand, his eyes deep and silent, his aura like an abyss waiting beneath calm water. The faint shadow of the broken gate seemed to linger behind him even while his Pseudo Cosmic Path was not active.

Revona sat quietly with her pale eyes fixed on the spinning names. The Void Origin Eyes did not glow violently, but the space near her gaze seemed strangely empty, as though even anticipation itself were being drawn toward nothingness.
Max Morgan stood on his pillar with Dragonheart resting at his waist. His expression remained calm, but a faint smile slowly appeared on his face.
The first name stopped.
[Revona]

The entire arena held its breath. The second name continued spinning. It passed Damian Voss, then Ervin, and then Max Morgan. Then the rotation slowed, the golden light flickered once, and the second name stopped.
[Max Morgan]
For a single instant, there was no sound. Then the Eternal Hourglass exploded.
[Final Undefeated Battle]
[Revona vs Max Morgan]

The Divine Realm erupted so violently that countless viewing formations trembled. In the Black Dragon Clan, disciples jumped to their feet and shouted Max’s name until their voices cracked. In distant halls, ancient families, hidden sects, and divine cities, countless spectators rose from their seats at the same time.

Some had wanted Max against Damian first. Some had wanted Max against Ervin. Some had wanted Revona against Damian. But the moment Revona and Max appeared together, every other thought was swallowed by excitement.
This was not merely a battle. This was the first collision among the undefeated monsters.
Max Morgan was the human genius who had stunned the Divine Realm again and again, the one who had defeated Rosaline, Rakan, Kaiden, Aurelian, Orion, and many others without losing once.
He carried Dragonheart, he had displayed the forbidden Emotion Severing Path, and his depth still seemed impossible to measure even after so many battles.

Revona was the silent genius with the Void Origin Eyes, the woman who had erased Orion’s stars, adapted against Rakan’s War God Body, resisted Kaiden’s Grand Void Labyrinth, and remained undefeated through every terrifying challenge placed before her.
Her power was not loud, but it was terrifying because it made even the strongest attacks feel meaningless once they entered her gaze.
The entire Divine Realm began shouting.
"Revona against Max!"
"The Void Origin Eyes against the Emotion Severing Path!"
"Can Revona erase Max’s sword?"
"Can Max sever the foundation of her void?"
"She defeated Orion, Rakan, and Kaiden, but Max has not been forced to reveal his full strength even once!"
"Do not underestimate her. Kaiden almost exiled her, and she still adapted. If she reads Max’s path, even he may be forced to reveal something deeper."
"What if her Void Origin Realm erases Dragonheart’s attacks?"

The Black Dragon Clan was roaring. The hidden forces watching Revona stayed silent but tense. The Sword God Palace disciples also watched closely, because Damian would eventually have to fight the winner, or perhaps both of them, depending on how the final sequence unfolded.
The same was true for the mysterious forces behind Ervin. Every piece of information from this battle would matter.
Rakan Thorne laughed loudly from his pillar. "This is good. This is very good."
Orion Starfall’s eyes shone with excitement. "I fought both of them. I still have no idea how this will go."
Morgana Starveil smiled faintly. "That is what makes it interesting. Revona does not need to overpower Max. She only needs to make his attacks disappear."
Kaiden Voidmere shook his head slightly. "That is easier said than done. Max’s path is not something that can be understood from the surface."

Ervin watched the two names quietly. Damian Voss also looked toward Max and Revona with deep focus. For the first time since his own last battle, Damian’s fingers rested lightly on the hilt of his sword. He did not move, but his attention had sharpened.
This battle would tell him something important about Max, and perhaps something equally important about Revona.
Above the arena, the screen continued shining.
[Revona vs Max Morgan]

On her pillar, Revona slowly stood. Her long hair drifted gently behind her, and her calm eyes turned toward Max. No fear appeared on her face, and no excitement appeared either. Yet the stillness around her deepened, and the faint emptiness in her gaze grew more obvious.

She knew what kind of opponent Max was. She had watched him defeat too many powerful geniuses without being pushed to the end. She had seen him use Dragonheart, the Emotion Severing Path, light power, body strength, and space mastery.
Even then, she understood one thing clearly. Max still had not revealed everything.
Max met her gaze from across the arena. For a brief moment, the two of them simply looked at each other. Then Max smiled, and that faint smile drew another wave of noise from the audience.
Revona spoke first, her voice quiet but clear enough to cross the silent gap between them. "I wondered when I would face you."
Max replied calmly, "And now you have your answer."
Revona’s eyes flickered slightly. "Your sword severs things that should not be cut. It is very strange."
Max’s hand rested on Dragonheart’s hilt. "The same is true for you. Your eyes erase things that should not disappear, and they do it in a very strange way as well."
A faint ripple passed through the air between them.
Revona said, "Then this battle will be meaningful."
Max smiled a little more. "Very."
Angelina Valerius looked at both of them, and even her calm eyes carried a trace of deeper attention now.

This was the first battle among the four undefeated participants. It would not merely add one win and one loss. It would break the perfect record of one monster and push the other closer to the final crown of the Cosmic Ascension Conference.
The golden laws of the Eternal Hourglass thickened around the arena barrier. The central stage restored itself fully, and the air became still. The entire Divine Realm leaned toward the screens.
Angelina raised her hand and announced in a clear voice.
"Revona."
"Max Morgan."
"Enter the stage."

chapters.title: Chapter 1903: Max vs Revona!

The two beams landed upon the central stage, and the first battle among the four undefeated participants officially entered the eyes of the entire Divine Realm.

Max Morgan appeared on one side of the arena with Dragonheart still sheathed at his waist and his white hair drifting slightly beneath the pressure of the Eternal Hourglass. He did not immediately draw his sword.

He did not release the Emotion Severing Path. He did not let seven-colored lightning flicker around his body, and he summoned no trace of his bloodline power. He simply stood there, calm and silent, his eyes resting on Revona with a thoughtful look.
Revona appeared opposite him. Her posture was still quiet, her expression unchanged, and her pale eyes carried that same terrifying emptiness that had made so many top geniuses feel helpless.
The Void Origin Eyes were fully open now. They were not burning wildly, and they released no obvious destructive pressure.

They were simply watching everything. The space around her gaze seemed to have grown thin and unreal, as if any power that entered that range would be studied, hollowed, erased, and returned to nothing before it could finish existing.
Angelina Valerius raised one hand above the arena, and the entire Divine Realm leaned forward.
[Battle Begins.]

Yet even after the announcement appeared, Max did not move. The audience froze for a moment. They had expected the first collision to explode instantly. They had expected Revona to open the Void Origin Realm at once, or Max to draw Dragonheart and sever space with that forbidden sword path.

Instead, Max remained where he was, his gaze calm and deep, as though he were not standing at the start of one of the most important battles of the entire Cosmic Ascension Conference, but studying a difficult problem that needed to be solved correctly before the first move.
Revona also did not attack immediately. She looked at him from across the stage and spoke in her usual calm voice. "You are not starting?"
Max smiled faintly. "Against others, starting first is useful. Against you, starting carelessly is foolish."
A slight ripple passed through the arena, and the defeated geniuses on the pillars reacted one after another.
Rakan Thorne frowned. "He is actually thinking first."
Orion Starfall smiled, though his expression was also serious. "That is the right choice. Attacking Revona without understanding her eyes is the same as throwing your technique into a grave."
Kaiden Voidmere looked at Max quietly. "I wonder if Max has some plan."
Damian Voss did not speak, but his eyes sharpened slightly. Ervin’s gaze stayed deep.
On the stage, Max’s thoughts moved quickly. He had faced Revona before. Back then, her Void Origin Eyes had already been dangerous, but they had not yet awakened fully.
Their ability to erase and nullify attacks had been frightening, yet it still held gaps. The timing had not been perfect.

The range had not been complete. The connection between her eyes, her perception, and her deeper void authority had still contained places that could be misled, bypassed, or overloaded. During that earlier clash, Max had been able to use those gaps to break past her defense.
But now things were different. Very different. Max could feel it.

Revona’s Void Origin Eyes had awakened fully. The pale emptiness within them no longer felt like a sharp ability aimed only at incoming techniques. It felt like a complete law of denial. Her eyes no longer merely erased attacks after seeing them.

They traced the structure behind the attacks. They found the source, the rhythm, the path, the intent, the hidden route, and the invisible support connecting technique to user. Kaiden’s Grand Void Labyrinth had proven that.

Even when Kaiden hid attacks through folded corridors, delayed spaces, mirror routes, and false paths, Revona had adapted. She had learned to trace the true route behind spatial techniques and erase them from their foundation.

That meant Max’s previous method would not work. If he tried to distract her vision with speed, she would read the intent behind the movement. If he tried to overwhelm her with multiple attacks, she would erase the structural roots one by one.

If he used pure sword force, the Void Origin Eyes would search for the sword rhythm and hollow it. If he released the Emotion Severing Path too directly, she might not erase the entire path, but she could still weaken the severing line before it reached her.
And if he relied on the Dimensional Sovereign Body or the Dragon Scales Transformation alone, he might win eventually through raw superiority, yet that would not truly solve the problem of her eyes.
Max narrowed his eyes slightly.
’Her eyes are not only defending now.’
He watched the faint emptiness around Revona’s pupils.
’They are learning. They are tracing. They are reading the cause behind every effect.’
A slow smile touched his lips, because that was exactly what made Revona terrifying. Orion’s stars were powerful because they burned brighter and stronger under pressure.
Rakan’s War God Body was terrifying because it grew more violent the more direct the battle became.
Kaiden’s Grand Void Labyrinth was dangerous because it turned the battlefield into an unreadable maze.
Damian’s Sword Sovereign Heaven was frightening because it could cut through the meaningful line behind everything.
But Revona’s Void Origin Eyes were dangerous because they punished repetition and obvious structure. The longer she watched, the more she understood, and the more she understood, the more she erased.
Her strongest ability was not simple nullification. It was adaptation through absolute perception.

Max could not treat her the way he had before. If he wanted to bypass her Void Origin Eyes now, he needed something entirely different. He could not merely move faster than her sight. He had to create an attack that her eyes could not properly define until it was already too late.

He could not merely release stronger sword force. He had to sever something that was not presented as an attack at first. He could not merely overwhelm her with power. He had to make her choose what to erase, and then punish the moment that choice created a gap.
Revona watched him quietly from the other side. "You are thinking about my eyes."
Max looked at her and smiled. "Of course."
Revona’s expression did not change. "You bypassed them before."
"I did."
"That will not work now."
"I know."

The simple exchange made the atmosphere grow even heavier. Across the Divine Realm, countless spectators felt their scalps turn numb, because even Max had admitted it. The old tactic would not work against the fully awakened Void Origin Eyes.
At the Black Dragon Clan, several elders grew solemn.
One elder whispered, "Senior Brother Max is being cautious."
Another elder nodded slowly. "He should be. Revona is not the kind of opponent one defeats by rushing in."
Lady Virelia watched the screen in silence, but a faint glint passed through her eyes. She had already seen many sides of Max, yet even now she could not fully understand the depth of his thinking.

This calm before the clash might look inactive to ordinary spectators, but to those at a high enough level, it was obvious that Max was already fighting. He was not exchanging blows with Revona yet, but he was searching for the correct line of victory.
Inside the Eternal Hourglass, Revona raised one hand, and a faint hollow ripple spread from her palm.
"You may think as long as you want," she said quietly. "I will still look."
Max’s smile deepened. "That is exactly the problem."

Dragonheart remained sheathed, but his fingers finally touched the hilt. The moment his hand rested there, Revona’s eyes flickered. It was not in fear. It was in focus. The pale emptiness in her pupils deepened, and the air between them grew strangely silent.
Max did not draw the sword yet. He simply stood there with his hand on Dragonheart, keeping his intent hidden beneath his calm.

He knew that the instant his sword left its sheath, Revona would begin reading the trajectory, the intent, the rhythm, and the severing foundation behind it. If he used the Emotion Severing Path in the same manner as before, she would respond faster than anyone else had.
So he needed to change the very nature of the first strike. He would have to use an attack she could not comprehend, one that even the Void Origin Eyes could not erase.

chapters.title: Chapter 1904: A Way
paragraphs: Revona’s gaze remained fixed on Max’s hand. Dragonheart had not left its sheath yet, but the faint hum coming from the sword made the stillness around the arena far more oppressive than an immediate clash would have been.

The spectators had expected flames of battle, thunderous sword light, collapsing void, and world-shaking techniques. Instead, Max and Revona stood across from each other like two people facing an invisible board where the first wrong move would decide everything.
Revona finally spoke again. "Did you find a way to bypass my ability?"
Her voice was quiet, yet because the whole arena had fallen silent, those words spread clearly through the Eternal Hourglass.
Max looked at her. Revona’s pale eyes were deeper than before, their emptiness no longer resembling a mere ability but a law that denied the meaning of whatever entered its sight.

She was not impatient, and she was not arrogant. She was asking because she could feel that Max’s thinking had changed, and because she knew he would not remain still unless he had understood something important.
Max smiled. "Yes."
The answer was simple, but the moment he said it, the atmosphere changed.
Revona’s eyes narrowed slightly, and across the Divine Realm, countless spectators felt their hearts tighten. He had found a way.
Max Morgan had stood still, studied the fully awakened Void Origin Eyes, admitted that his previous method would no longer work, and now calmly claimed that he had found a way to bypass them.
No one knew whether those words were confidence or madness.
Then Max’s aura began to rise. At first it was only a faint vibration beneath his skin, so quiet that ordinary spectators barely noticed it.

Then the ground beneath his feet trembled, and the air around his body began distorting as if a hidden furnace had awakened inside him. His white hair lifted slightly, and deep within his body, four ancient gates seemed to open one after another.
The first vein awakened.
"Seven Divine Veins."
Max’s voice was calm.
"Vein of Opening."
Boom!
A terrifying foundational force burst out from his body. It did not look like ordinary energy, and it did not feel like simple bloodline pressure.

It was deeper, older, and heavier, as though some sealed origin inside Max had opened its first door and let a forgotten power flow through his limbs. His aura became clearer and more stable, and the entire stage shook beneath that first wave of pressure.
The second vein followed immediately.
"Vein of Vitality."
A vast life force erupted inside him. The energy around Max grew denser, thicker, and more oppressive. It was not the gentle vitality that healed wounds quietly.

It was a ferocious vitality, the kind that made the body feel indestructible and made every bone, vein, muscle, and drop of blood seem capable of enduring impossible pressure. The spectators could almost hear his body roaring.
The third vein opened.
"Vein of Speed."

The air around Max blurred. For a brief instant, his figure seemed to exist in several positions at once. It was not an illusion, and it was not space folding. His body’s movement potential had simply risen beyond what ordinary perception could hold.
The light around him stretched, and the dust near his feet rose and froze in strange curved lines, as though time itself had been forced to acknowledge the sudden increase in his speed.
The fourth vein opened.
"Vein of Strength."
Boom!

This time the entire arena trembled violently. A crushing physical pressure swept outward from Max like a divine mountain waking from ancient sleep. The barrier around the stage lit up, and the golden laws of the Eternal Hourglass flowed through it to contain the force.

Max had not thrown a punch, and he had not drawn his sword. He had merely opened four of the Seven Divine Veins, yet the pressure released from his body already made many participants feel their breathing grow heavy.
Rakan Thorne stood up from his pillar, his eyes widening with battle-crazed shock. Is that the full power of that technique?"
Orion Starfall’s smile vanished for once, replaced by pure astonishment. "He did not use this against me."
Kaiden Voidmere stared at Max with a solemn expression. "Nor against me. But I think this is the true power of the Seven Divine Veins."
Morgana Starveil’s purple eyes flickered. "So he still had this much hidden?"
Damian Voss’s gaze sharpened like a drawn blade. Ervin’s eyes deepened, and for the first time the faint shadow behind him stirred slightly without being summoned.
Even Revona’s expression changed. Only slightly, but it changed.

Max stood in the middle of that terrifying storm with his body surrounded by four layers of divine-vein power. Opening, Vitality, Speed, and Strength did not act separately. They fused together inside him, each one reinforcing the others and each one making the next more overwhelming.

His foundation opened, his life force surged, his speed sharpened, and his strength became monstrous. The energy around him was no longer merely powerful. It was devastating, wild, and almost unbearable to watch directly.
The Divine Realm erupted.
"He still had this hidden!"
"What kind of cultivation art is that?"
"Is this the first time Max Morgan is going all out?"
"He did not use this against Rakan!"
"He did not use this against Orion either!"

Across countless viewing halls, elders rose from their seats. Some were shocked by the pressure, some were horrified by the foundation, and some stared at Max as if they were watching a monster whose true shape had finally begun to appear.

At the Black Dragon Clan, the disciples were almost mad with excitement. Many of them had already believed that Max had revealed most of his strength after defeating so many top geniuses, but now they realized how wrong they had been.
Even when he defeated Rakan in a pure body battle, he had not used all of this. Even when he fought Orion’s Nine Star Sovereign Body, he had not released this level of divine-vein power.
Lady Virelia’s eyes shone brightly. "So this is what you were still keeping hidden."
On the stage, Revona looked at the storm of power surrounding Max and spoke quietly. "You plan to bypass my eyes with raw speed and strength?"
Max smiled faintly. "No."
The answer made her gaze sharpen again. Max’s fingers still rested on Dragonheart’s hilt, but he did not draw it yet. "This is only to make sure I can stand at the right place when I need to."
The meaning behind those words made the top geniuses narrow their eyes. He was not claiming the four divine veins were his answer. He was saying they were only preparation.
Revona understood that as well, and the emptiness in her eyes deepened. "Then show me the rest."

Max looked at her for a breath. Then the sky above the arena darkened, and a rumble echoed. At first it sounded distant, like thunder rolling from beyond the world. Then seven colors began flickering in the air above Max.

Red, orange, gold, green, azure, indigo, and violet lightning appeared one after another, and each strand carried a different kind of destructive pressure. When they began twisting together, the entire Eternal Hourglass seemed to tremble.

The expressions of countless spectators changed. They had seen traces of Max’s seven-colored lightning before. They had seen him use it to erase attacks, to crush enemies, and to display an authority that felt like judgment. But this was different. This was not a faint spark, and it was not a casual release. This was the descent of the true path behind that lightning.
Max slowly raised his head.
"Pseudo Cosmic Path."

chapters.title: Chapter 1905: Lightning Plus Speed and Strength!
paragraphs: The seven-colored thunder above him exploded outward. A vast storm world appeared behind him, filled with endless punishment lightning. The sky became a divine tribunal. Thunder pillars descended like heavenly verdicts.

At the center of the storm, a vague throne formed from seven-colored lightning, and above that throne, countless thunder symbols rotated with terrifying majesty. Every strand of lightning carried destruction.
Every rumble felt like judgment. Every flicker seemed to declare that something in the world had been found guilty and would now be punished.
"Divine King Punishment."
Boom!

The Pseudo Cosmic Path fully descended. The four opened Divine Veins roared inside Max’s body at the same time, and the seven-colored lightning wrapped around him like the cloak of a thunder sovereign.

Strength, vitality, speed, foundation, destruction, judgment, and punishment gathered into one terrifying presence. The pressure around Max grew so devastating that the stage beneath him cracked again and again despite the Eternal Hourglass repairing it continuously.
The Divine Realm went completely mad.
"Another Pseudo Cosmic Path!"
"He has that strange sword cosmic path, and now this seven-colored lightning path too?"
"What kind of monster has two Pseudo Cosmic Paths?"
"No, this is not normal. This cannot be normal!"
"Is he finally going all out?"
The top geniuses were no longer calm. Rakan’s battle intent burned wildly, yet even he understood that this level of pressure was not something he could challenge lightly.
Orion laughed in disbelief. "So that is what he kept hidden against me."

Kaiden’s eyes flickered. "Four divine veins, Dragonheart, a strange but terrifying sword cosmic path, and now the seven-colored lightning cosmic path he used against Morgana last time. He is stacking powers before Revona can read a single stable rhythm."
Morgana Starveil murmured, "But will that be enough against Revona?"
Damian Voss stared at Max with unprecedented focus. Ervin’s hand tightened around his spear.

Revona stood opposite Max with her Void Origin Eyes fully open, her expression calm yet her aura clearly turning more serious. She had defeated every opponent so far by seeing, tracing, erasing, and hollowing the foundation of their attacks.

But Max was no longer presenting her with one clean structure to read. His body was empowered by four divine veins. His weapon still waited inside its sheath. His severing path had not yet been released.

His seven-colored lightning Pseudo Cosmic Path had descended like judgment from the heavens. Multiple sources of power overlapped around him, each one terrifying, each one different, and each one capable of becoming the true attack or merely a decoy.
Max looked at Revona through the seven-colored lightning storm. "You can erase what you see and understand."
His smile became sharper. "So I will not give you only one thing to understand."

Dragonheart finally began to leave its sheath. The sound of the blade sliding free spread through the arena like a cold line drawn across the soul. It was not loud, but it silenced the endless thunder for a brief instant.

The seven-colored lightning above Max kept roaring, the four Divine Veins inside his body kept blazing, and the dreadful pressure of Divine King Punishment kept descending like judgment from a sky that had already chosen its criminal.

Revona’s Void Origin Eyes brightened. She did not speak. The emptiness around her gaze grew deeper, more focused, and more dangerous than before. Her eyes locked onto Max’s hand, then Dragonheart, then the seven-colored lightning, and then the divine-vein aura moving through his body.
In that instant, her perception divided itself into several layers, each one trying to trace a different source of power.

She was not looking only at Max’s sword. She was looking at the movement of his muscles, the rhythm of his breathing, the flow of his opened veins, the descent pattern of Divine King Punishment, and the hidden line of the Emotion Severing Path that had not yet been fully released.
That was what made her terrifying.
But Max moved before she could settle on one structure.
Boom!
The ground beneath him exploded. The Vein of Speed released its full power, and Max vanished from his original position so suddenly that even the top geniuses felt their eyes tighten.
It was not spatial movement, and it was not illusion. It was raw speed, pure physical motion elevated by a divine vein until the distance between him and Revona seemed to collapse beneath his feet.
Revona’s eyes shifted instantly, and a hollow ripple spread in front of her.
"Void Origin Eyes."

The space before her began to empty, trying to erase the incoming path of Max’s first strike. If he continued along that direct route, his sword momentum, physical rhythm, and even the structure of his attack would be hollowed before Dragonheart reached her.
But Max did not continue along that route. At the final instant, the Vein of Strength roared, and his foot slammed into the stage. The entire direction of his body changed with impossible violence.
Crack!

The stage beneath him shattered in a wide spiderweb, and his figure bent away from the hollow ripple without losing momentum. Using brute strength to alter the path that speed had created, Max appeared at Revona’s right side and slashed with Dragonheart.
Revona turned her gaze, and the slash began to fade. But above her, Divine King Punishment descended.
"Punishment Lightning, First Verdict."
A seven-colored thunderbolt fell from the storm world behind Max, not toward her head, but toward the ground behind her, where the Void Origin Realm would normally expand to support her retreat.
Revona’s eyes flickered. For the first time, she had to choose. Should she erase the sword? Should she erase the lightning? Should she read Max’s body, or seal off her own retreat route?
Her response was almost perfect.
Her right eye locked onto Dragonheart and hollowed the surface sword light before it could fully touch her.

Her left eye traced the descending punishment lightning and weakened its destructive authority before it reached the ground. At the same time, her body shifted half a step to avoid the physical edge of Max’s blade.

But Max’s Vein of Strength erupted again. His sword, which should have been weakened by the Void Origin Eyes, suddenly gained a crushing physical force behind it. The sword light had faded, but the sword itself had not.
Dragonheart’s actual blade carried Max’s raw strength, and the strike slammed into Revona’s hastily raised palm guard.
Boom!
Revona slid backward only three steps, but she had retreated first.
The entire Divine Realm erupted.
"He pushed her back!"
"Revona’s eyes erased the sword light, but Max used raw strength through the weapon!"
"He changed direction with his body alone!"
"And the lightning forced her to divide her sight!"

On the pillars, Kaiden Voidmere’s eyes turned extremely serious. "That is his method," he said quietly. "He is not trying to bypass her eyes with one perfect trick. He is overloading the process behind them."

Orion Starfall leaned forward, his exhaustion forgotten for a moment. "Speed to create pressure, strength to change direction, lightning to force decisions, and the sword to punish the gap. That is insane."
Rakan Thorne grinned like a madman. "Good. This is close combat."
Morgana Starveil narrowed her eyes. "It is more than close combat. He is making her eyes work against too many kinds of danger at once."
Damian Voss watched silently. Ervin’s gaze stayed deep, but his grip on his spear tightened slightly.
On the stage, Revona stopped sliding. Her expression remained calm, but the emptiness in her eyes was brighter than before. "Your body is troublesome," she said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1906: Pressurizing Revona!
paragraphs: Max smiled faintly. "That is only one part."

He moved again. This time he did not charge in a straight line. The Vein of Speed carried him across the arena in a blur, while the Vein of Strength let him change direction violently without slowing down.
He moved left, then forward, then vanished to the right, then appeared above her with Dragonheart descending in both hands. Each step shattered the stage.
Each change of direction left cracks in the air. His body no longer followed ordinary combat rhythm. It moved like a thunderbolt wearing flesh.
Revona raised her hand. She finally used her Pseudo Cosmic Path.
"Void Origin Realm."
A hollow world unfolded behind her. The moment it appeared, Max’s seven-colored lightning field dimmed slightly near its edge.
Several punishment bolts vanished before they could descend, swallowed by the origin-level emptiness. Dragonheart’s sword aura also began to thin wherever it entered the realm’s range.
But Max had expected that. The Vein of Opening pulsed inside him, and his foundation aura expanded to stabilize his body against the hollowing pressure of the Void Origin Realm.

The Vein of Vitality followed, surging through his flesh with monstrous force and letting him withstand the drain that would have weakened most opponents instantly. Then the Vein of Speed and the Vein of Strength roared together, and Max crashed into the edge of the Void Origin Realm instead of retreating from it.
"Divine King Punishment, Thunder Chain Judgment."

Seven-colored lightning chains descended from above, each one striking from a different direction. Revona’s eyes moved rapidly. Two chains vanished, three chains weakened, and one chain was redirected by the Void Origin Realm.
But Max hid behind the final chain. His body appeared through the seven-colored thunder with Dragonheart already slashing toward her waist.
Revona’s eyes shifted toward him.
"Void Origin Eyes, Hollow Sight."
The slash began disappearing. But Max’s wrist changed angle. The Vein of Strength gave him enough control to force Dragonheart into a second trajectory after the first had already been erased.
The first sword line vanished beneath Revona’s eyes, but the real blade curved underneath the fading sword light and struck upward.
Revona’s body leaned back, and the blade missed her throat by a narrow margin. A thin line of blood appeared beneath her chin.
The arena went silent for a breath. Then it erupted even louder. Blood. Max had drawn blood from Revona during the first true close-range exchange.
Revona touched the wound lightly, and her eyes turned colder.
"Void Origin Realm, Silent Collapse."
The hollow world behind her pulsed, and the air around Max suddenly began vanishing in layers. It was not just the attacks, and it was not just the sword aura.
The space near his limbs, the lightning around his body, and the movement path beneath his feet all began collapsing into nothingness at the same time.

Max’s expression sharpened. The Vein of Speed erupted, and he vanished from the collapsing zone before it fully closed. But Revona’s eyes followed him instantly, and a void ripple appeared where he was about to land.

Most opponents would have been forced to stop. Max did not. The Vein of Strength exploded through his legs. Instead of landing where Revona expected, he stomped midair with pure physical force and altered his descent by twisting his own momentum.
His figure slammed down behind her, and Dragonheart cut horizontally.
Revona turned halfway and raised her palm.
"Void Origin Palm."
The hollow palm seal met Dragonheart.
Boom!
The clash produced no ordinary explosion. Sword force, void emptiness, divine-vein strength, and seven-colored lightning collided in one compressed point.
The surrounding ground vanished in one area and shattered in another. The barrier of the Eternal Hourglass trembled, and golden laws poured down to stabilize the stage.
Revona’s palm trembled. Max’s sword pressed forward. The Vein of Strength roared louder, and for a moment, Revona was actually being forced back in a direct collision.

That sight brought countless elders across the Divine Realm to their feet. Orion Starfall had pushed Revona into using Return To Nothing. Kaiden Voidmere had almost exiled her. Rakan Thorne had forced her to adapt against the War God Body.

But Max was doing something different. He was pressuring her from everywhere at once. He did not rely on one decisive attack, and he did not rely on one overwhelming technique. He was forcing her mind, her eyes, her body, her realm, and her perception to defend against several completely different threats at the same time.

Dragonheart pressed from close range. The Vein of Strength turned every blocked sword strike into a mountain-splitting collision. The Vein of Speed prevented her from locking down his path for more than a breath.

The Vein of Opening stabilized his foundation whenever the Void Origin Realm tried to hollow his power. The Vein of Vitality let him withstand the drain and recoil of fighting inside her field. Divine King Punishment attacked from above, from behind, from beneath, and from beyond her blind angles.
And every time Revona tried to erase one danger, Max used another to break through the gap left behind.
Max twisted Dragonheart, and a seven-colored bolt descended onto the blade.
"Punishment Sword Strike."

The sword came down with thunder judgment wrapped around its edge. Revona’s Void Origin Eyes flashed, and the lightning on the blade began to vanish. But the sword beneath it still carried divine-vein strength.
She shifted her gaze to the sword, and the physical strike weakened. But the lightning above her condensed into another verdict.
"Divine King Punishment, Second Verdict."
Boom!

The lightning bolt descended directly toward her shoulder. Revona opened the Void Origin Realm wider, causing the bolt to hollow out before impact, but that small expansion forced the realm’s pressure to shift outward for a fraction of a breath.
Max used that fraction. The Vein of Speed activated to its peak, and he appeared inside her defensive range. His left hand left Dragonheart’s hilt for the first time and formed a fist.
"Vein of Strength."

The punch drove forward. Revona’s eyes widened slightly. She erased the first layer of force, but the second layer remained. She hollowed the second, but the third layer arrived through Max’s physical body before the technique structure could be fully read.
Boom!
The punch struck her crossed arms, and Revona was blasted backward across the stage. Her feet carved two long lines into the ground before she steadied herself near the edge of the Void Origin Realm.
A drop of blood fell from the corner of her mouth.
The Divine Realm went crazy.
"He pushed her that far!"
"Max is pressuring Revona even more heavily than Orion did!"
"No, this is different. Orion forced her with one supreme destructive attack. Max is making her defend every second!"
"She cannot read everything fast enough!"
"His divine veins are too strong!"
"And the seven-colored lightning is attacking from long range while he fights close!"

At the Black Dragon Clan, the disciples were shouting so loudly that the entire hall shook. Among the forces watching Revona, the atmosphere became suffocating. Their genius had never looked weak, and she still did not look weak. But she was being pressured, truly pressured.

Inside the Eternal Hourglass, Revona slowly straightened. The wound beneath her chin, the blood at the corner of her lips, the strain in her aura, and the faint trembling of her fingers all proved that Max’s strategy was working.
Her Void Origin Eyes were still terrifying, yet even they needed to choose what to erase, and Max was constantly creating choices too close together for comfort.
Revona looked at him quietly. "You are forcing too many sources at once."
Max stood amid the seven-colored thunder with Dragonheart in hand and four Divine Veins roaring inside his body. "That was the idea."
Revona’s eyes deepened. "Then I will stop watching them separately."

The Void Origin Realm behind her became silent. Very silent. The emptiness condensed around her eyes, and for the first time in the battle, the whole arena felt the pressure of something far deeper awakening inside Revona’s gaze.
Max smiled faintly, but his grip on Dragonheart tightened.

chapters.title: Chapter 1907: Devouring Flames Domain!
paragraphs: Revona’s words had barely faded when the entire arena fell silent again.
"Then I will stop watching them separately."

The Void Origin Realm behind her no longer expanded outward. Instead it condensed, drawing inward as the hollow world that had spread across the battlefield began collapsing around her eyes, her palms, and the empty space between her and Max.
The pressure of that emptiness became terrifyingly pure, as if Revona had decided to stop erasing Max’s attacks one by one and instead erase the entire meaning of the battlefield before him.

Max’s eyes sharpened as he felt the change at once. This was no longer the same defensive nullification she had used earlier, nor was it merely the Void Origin Eyes tracking his sword, his lightning, his movement, and his divine-vein rhythm.

This was something much deeper. The Void Origin Realm was gathering all the power it had erased, all the hollow authority it had accumulated, and all the origin-level emptiness that made Revona so frightening into a single point.
The pale light in Revona’s eyes vanished, replaced by absolute darkness without color, weight, or sound. She raised one hand as the air before her palm began to hollow.
"Void Origin Realm."
The hollow point solidified before her palm, drawing the emptiness around it into a single condensed core.
"Return To Nothing."

The moment those words fell, the whole stage seemed to lose its hold on existence. The seven-colored lightning around Max dimmed violently, and the cracks in the ground disappeared, not because they were repaired but because the damage, the ground, the sound, and the very concept of impact were being dragged into a silent point of origin emptiness.
The storm of Divine King Punishment trembled while Dragonheart’s hum quieted, and even Max’s four Divine Veins felt the pressure of being hollowed from the outside inward.
Across the Divine Realm, countless spectators lost their voices. They had seen Return To Nothing before.

Against Orion, it had erased the terrifying Starfall Extinction and turned collapsing star power into emptiness. Against Rakan, it had nullified the core force of his strongest War God Body strike. Against Kaiden, it had entered the Final Corridor and hollowed the Void Beyond Return from within.
Now it was being used against Max, and this time Revona was not using it defensively. She was attacking.

The point of nothingness moved toward Max, slow, almost too slow to seem dangerous. But no one laughed at that slowness, because everyone understood that speed was meaningless before it. It did not need to chase like lightning, and it did not need to cut like a sword.
Anything that entered its range would be erased from the foundation, and the more power used to resist it, the more material it would have to return to nothing.
Max stood still for one breath. Then black flames erupted from his body.
Boom!

The stage vanished beneath a wave of darkness. It was not the darkness of the abyss, and it was not the emptiness of void. It was flame, pure flame, but blacker than a moonless night and hungrier than a bottomless beast.
The flames burst from Max’s body, from beneath his feet, from the air around Dragonheart, and from the cracks in space itself, expanding outward in the next instant with terrifying violence.
"Pseudo Cosmic Path."
Max’s voice sounded from within the black fire.
"Devouring Flames Domain."

The entire arena shook as a vast domain of black flames descended and swallowed both Max and Revona. The flames rose into walls, waves, pillars, and burning curtains so dense that even the viewing formations of the Eternal Hourglass flickered.

For the first time in the final competitive stage, the spectators outside could no longer see the full battle clearly. They could only see an enormous black-flame domain occupying the central arena, its surface constantly writhing as if countless ancient dragons and devouring beasts were moving beneath the fire.
The Divine Realm exploded in shock.
"Another Pseudo Cosmic Path!"
"Black flames!"
"How many Pseudo Cosmic Paths does Max Morgan have?"
"No, this is impossible. A sword path, lightning path and now even a flames path?"
"The domain blocked the view!"
"What is happening inside?"
Even the top geniuses on the pillars were shaken. Rakan Thorne stared at the black-flame domain with wide eyes.
"That bastard still had another path?"
Orion Starfall’s expression froze before he laughed in disbelief.
"I thought he had already shown enough against me. He was hiding this too?"
Kaiden Voidmere’s eyes narrowed as he tried to sense through the domain, but the black flames swallowed even the faint spatial perception he released.
"This flame has devouring nature.... If I am not wrong this should be flames form the black dragon bloodline the disciples of the Black Dragon Palace carries among them."
Damian Voss’s hand tightened around his sword hilt while Ervin’s abyss-like gaze grew heavier.
Inside the Devouring Flames Domain, the outside world disappeared entirely. There was no audience, no pillars, and no golden arena. Only black fire remained.

Revona stood within the domain, her eyes fully open, her Return To Nothing still moving forward like the condensed will of origin emptiness. The black flames immediately surged toward it, devouring the outer layer of hollow power the moment both forces touched.
For the first time, Return To Nothing slowed.
Max stood opposite her, surrounded by black flames, seven-colored lightning, and the pressure of four opened Divine Veins. His face was calm, but his eyes were sharper than before.

The Devouring Flames Domain did not try to erase Revona’s attack. It consumed. It ate the power that Return To Nothing carried, swallowed the hollow ripples around it, and burned away the erased fragments before they could fully return to origin emptiness.
The black flames curled around the point of nothingness like countless hungry serpents, biting into the surrounding void power again and again.
Revona’s eyes narrowed.
"Your flames devour nullification."
Max replied calmly, "Not all of it."

He was being honest. The Devouring Flames Domain was terrifying, but Return To Nothing was also Revona’s strongest ability. The black flames could devour its outer layers, weaken its momentum, and prevent it from expanding freely, but they could not swallow the entire technique outright.

At the center of Return To Nothing, origin emptiness still remained absolute, and every time the black flames tried to consume too deeply, that emptiness erased the devouring structure before the flames could complete the act.

sentences.text: Revona’s words had barely faded when the entire arena fell silent again.
"Then I will stop watching them separately."
The Void Origin Realm behind her no longer expanded outward.
Instead it condensed, drawing inward as the hollow world that had spread across the battlefield began collapsing around her eyes, her palms, and the empty space between her and Max.
The pressure of that emptiness became terrifyingly pure, as if Revona had decided to stop erasing Max’s attacks one by one and instead erase the entire meaning of the battlefield before him.
Max’s eyes sharpened as he felt the change at once.
This was no longer the same defensive nullification she had used earlier, nor was it merely the Void Origin Eyes tracking his sword, his lightning, his movement, and his divine-vein rhythm.
This was something much deeper.
The Void Origin Realm was gathering all the power it had erased, all the hollow authority it had accumulated, and all the origin-level emptiness that made Revona so frightening into a single point.
The pale light in Revona’s eyes vanished, replaced by absolute darkness without color, weight, or sound.
She raised one hand as the air before her palm began to hollow.
"Void Origin Realm."
The hollow point solidified before her palm, drawing the emptiness around it into a single condensed core.
"Return To Nothing."
The moment those words fell, the whole stage seemed to lose its hold on existence.

The seven-colored lightning around Max dimmed violently, and the cracks in the ground disappeared, not because they were repaired but because the damage, the ground, the sound, and the very concept of impact were being dragged into a silent point of origin emptiness.
The storm of Divine King Punishment trembled while Dragonheart’s hum quieted, and even Max’s four Divine Veins felt the pressure of being hollowed from the outside inward.
Across the Divine Realm, countless spectators lost their voices.
They had seen Return To Nothing before.
Against Orion, it had erased the terrifying Starfall Extinction and turned collapsing star power into emptiness.
Against Rakan, it had nullified the core force of his strongest War God Body strike.
Against Kaiden, it had entered the Final Corridor and hollowed the Void Beyond Return from within.
Now it was being used against Max, and this time Revona was not using it defensively.
She was attacking.
The point of nothingness moved toward Max, slow, almost too slow to seem dangerous.
But no one laughed at that slowness, because everyone understood that speed was meaningless before it.
It did not need to chase like lightning, and it did not need to cut like a sword.
Anything that entered its range would be erased from the foundation, and the more power used to resist it, the more material it would have to return to nothing.
Max stood still for one breath.
Then black flames erupted from his body.
Boom!
The stage vanished beneath a wave of darkness.
It was not the darkness of the abyss, and it was not the emptiness of void.
It was flame, pure flame, but blacker than a moonless night and hungrier than a bottomless beast.
The flames burst from Max’s body, from beneath his feet, from the air around Dragonheart, and from the cracks in space itself, expanding outward in the next instant with terrifying violence.
"Pseudo Cosmic Path."
Max’s voice sounded from within the black fire.
"Devouring Flames Domain."
The entire arena shook as a vast domain of black flames descended and swallowed both Max and Revona.
The flames rose into walls, waves, pillars, and burning curtains so dense that even the viewing formations of the Eternal Hourglass flickered.
For the first time in the final competitive stage, the spectators outside could no longer see the full battle clearly.
They could only see an enormous black-flame domain occupying the central arena, its surface constantly writhing as if countless ancient dragons and devouring beasts were moving beneath the fire.
The Divine Realm exploded in shock.
"Another Pseudo Cosmic Path!"
"Black flames!"
"How many Pseudo Cosmic Paths does Max Morgan have?"
"No, this is impossible.
A sword path, lightning path and now even a flames path?"
"The domain blocked the view!"
"What is happening inside?"
Even the top geniuses on the pillars were shaken.
Rakan Thorne stared at the black-flame domain with wide eyes.
"That bastard still had another path?"
Orion Starfall’s expression froze before he laughed in disbelief.
"I thought he had already shown enough against me.
He was hiding this too?"
Kaiden Voidmere’s eyes narrowed as he tried to sense through the domain, but the black flames swallowed even the faint spatial perception he released.
"This flame has devouring nature....
If I am not wrong this should be flames form the black dragon bloodline the disciples of the Black Dragon Palace carries among them."
Damian Voss’s hand tightened around his sword hilt while Ervin’s abyss-like gaze grew heavier.
Inside the Devouring Flames Domain, the outside world disappeared entirely.
There was no audience, no pillars, and no golden arena.
Only black fire remained.
Revona stood within the domain, her eyes fully open, her Return To Nothing still moving forward like the condensed will of origin emptiness.
The black flames immediately surged toward it, devouring the outer layer of hollow power the moment both forces touched.

chapters.title: Chapter 1908: Null Origin Tide!
paragraphs: Revona raised her other hand as the Void Origin Eyes shone through the black fire.
"Then I will nullify the devouring power as well."

A pale hollow ripple spread from her gaze, and the black flames nearest to Return To Nothing began fading. Max’s Devouring Flames Domain roared as the flames surged again, trying to feed on the nullifying ripple.

But Revona’s Void Origin Eyes locked onto the structure of the devouring authority and erased several layers of it before it could bite back. For a moment, the battlefield inside the domain settled into a horrifying balance.
Max’s black flames devoured the outer power of Return To Nothing, while Revona’s eyes nullified the devouring process itself.

Neither side could completely overwhelm the other, but the clash was forcing both of them toward their limits. Max’s four Divine Veins roared inside him, Divine King Punishment continued rumbling above, and Dragonheart trembled in his hand.
The Devouring Flames Domain kept burning, yet Revona’s Return To Nothing still advanced inch by inch.
Max’s eyes turned colder.
’Not enough.’
The four Divine Veins had pushed his body beyond what most geniuses could imagine, and the Devouring Flames Domain had created the hidden battlefield he needed.

Divine King Punishment forced pressure from above while Dragonheart and the Emotion Severing Path still waited for the decisive moment. But against Revona’s fully awakened Void Origin Eyes and Return To Nothing, even that was not enough to guarantee victory.
He needed a gap. A real gap. Something Revona could not see in time, something that would arrive outside the rhythm of what her eyes were reading.
Max inhaled slowly. Then the 5000 Draconic Essences within him awakened, all of them at once.
Boom!
His body erupted with a roar that sounded like thousands of dragons awakening inside a single human frame.

The black flames bent around him, the Divine King Punishment trembled above him, and his veins, bones, flesh, and blood all released an ancient draconic pressure that caused even the Devouring Flames Domain to expand violently.

The first hundred essences ignited. Then five hundred. Then a thousand. Then two thousand. Then all five thousand Draconic Essences blazed at once, and Max’s physical aura changed completely. It became savage, ancient, oppressive, and impossibly heavy.
Then black dragon scales spread across his body.
"Dragon Scales Transformation."
The transformation did not appear as a simple armor this time.

The scales emerged with the full support of the 5000 Draconic Essences, each one looking like a fragment of a chaotic black dragon’s hide, hard enough to resist divine weapons and dense enough to carry the weight of ancient bloodline pressure.
His hands became claw-like beneath the scale armor, his shoulders widened slightly, and his pupils sharpened as the aura around him rose beyond the level created by the four Divine Veins alone.
The Vein of Opening stabilized his foundation. The Vein of Vitality fed the transformation. The Vein of Speed sharpened his movement, and the Vein of Strength fused with the draconic essences.
But the full Dragon Scales Transformation pushed everything further, far further, and Max’s physical strength broke past its previous limit.
Revona’s expression finally became truly solemn. The Return To Nothing continued moving, but Max stepped forward through its pressure.
One step, and the black flames around his scales were erased. The lightning near his shoulder vanished, but his body did not stop.
Second step, and the Devouring Flames Domain roared, swallowing more of the outer void power.
Third step, and the 5000 Draconic Essences pushed his body forward against the hollowing force.
Revona’s eyes flashed as she raised her hand and focused Return To Nothing directly toward his chest.

Max disappeared. Not with space, and not with ordinary speed. The Vein of Speed, Dragon Scales Transformation, and 5000 Draconic Essences erupted together, and his body moved so violently that the black flames behind him exploded into a tidal wave.
Revona’s eyes followed Max, and they still found him.

Even inside the Devouring Flames Domain, even with black flames devouring perception from every direction, even with Divine King Punishment raining seven-colored thunder from above, and even with four Divine Veins roaring inside Max’s body alongside 5000 Draconic Essences pushing his Dragon Scales Transformation beyond its previous limit, those terrifying Void Origin Eyes still locked onto his movement.
But at that exact moment, the clone moved out of his dimensional space.

Hidden deep within the black flames, where the outside world could not see and where even Revona’s sight was being forced to divide itself among too many dangers at once, the clone released the Time Concept.

It did not attack Revona directly, and it did not create killing intent. It did not aim to pierce, burn, crush, or bind her. It only touched the rhythm of time inside the Devouring Flames Domain with delicate precision.

For a fraction of a breath, the black flames near Revona slowed. For another fraction, the flow around Max’s body accelerated. The difference was tiny, too tiny for ordinary geniuses to notice. But against someone like Revona, even that small delay should have been enough.

Max’s figure vanished from the path her Void Origin Eyes were reading and reappeared at her side, his scaled body moving with the combined force of the Vein of Speed, Vein of Strength, Dragon Scales Transformation, and 5000 Draconic Essences. Dragonheart rose in his hand, and the Emotion Severing Path condensed along the edge of the blade with cold and silent killing precision.

Revona’s eyes shifted. The clone tightened the Time Concept, and a brief temporal heaviness descended around her body. It was not a full stop, and it was not enough to freeze the world, but it was enough to delay her action for the smallest moment.
Max’s sword began to fall. For the first time, the strike seemed as though it would truly arrive before Revona’s Void Origin Eyes could perfectly align with the present.
Then Revona’s expression changed. Not into panic, and not into fear, but into absolute calm.

Her eyes stopped chasing Max’s sword. They stopped chasing the clone. They stopped chasing the lightning, the black flames, the draconic aura, and the divine-vein force. Instead, the Void Origin Realm inside her pupils suddenly expanded outward.
"Void Origin Realm."
Her voice was quiet, but it spread through the black flames like a verdict from emptiness itself.
"Null Origin Tide."

chapters.title: Chapter 1909: Stripped Away of All His Powers!
paragraphs: Boom!

A pale-gray wave erupted from Revona’s body in every direction. It was not like Return To Nothing. Return To Nothing was a condensed point, a terrifying origin of emptiness that gathered all nullified power into one core and returned everything before it to nothingness.

This attack was different. It was larger, wider, and far more reckless. Instead of gathering power into a single point, it released the Void Origin Realm outward as a massive domain-like tide of nullifying energy that spread in all directions at once.

The black flames were the first to touch it. They did not devour it, though they tried. The Devouring Flames Domain roared like a starving beast, sending countless black-flame currents toward the pale-gray tide.
Under ordinary circumstances, Max’s black flames would eat power, burn authority, and consume even the structure of techniques.

But the Null Origin Tide was not a normal technique. It carried the same foundation as Revona’s fully awakened Void Origin Eyes, and because it spread in every direction at once, there was no single core for the flames to swallow cleanly.
The black flames touched the tide. Then they vanished. Not burned out, and not weakened. Simply vanished.

Max’s eyes widened slightly. The seven-colored lightning of Divine King Punishment descended from above, trying to pierce the tide with heavenly judgment, but the moment the lightning entered the pale-gray wave, its destructive authority dulled, flickered, and disappeared as if it had never been released.
The black flames around Max’s body dimmed, the draconic pressure covering his scales cracked, and the roaring force of the 5000 Draconic Essences inside him suddenly dropped like a collapsing tide.
Then the four Divine Veins were struck. The Vein of Opening dimmed. The Vein of Vitality stopped surging. The Vein of Speed lost its brilliance, and the Vein of Strength fell silent.
Max felt it all vanish from his body in a single breath. His terrifying physical pressure disappeared, and the full power of the 5000 Draconic Essences was suppressed.

The Dragon Scales Transformation covering his body began fading layer by layer, the Devouring Flames Domain lost its devouring authority, and even the storm world of Divine King Punishment trembled above him before breaking apart into scattered seven-colored sparks.
For the first time in the entire Cosmic Ascension Conference, Max felt his body become empty. Not injured, and not exhausted in the normal sense.
Just empty. It felt as though someone had dried every source of power inside his body and left only the shape of a person behind.
The divine veins that had thundered a moment ago became silent, and the draconic essences that had roared like thousands of dragons became still.

The dragon scales that had made his body stronger than ever before faded from his skin, the black flames around him no longer answered his command properly, and even the seven-colored lightning above the domain collapsed into darkness.
Only Dragonheart remained in his hand, and only the Emotion Severing Path around the sword still existed. But even that was beginning to dull.

The cold severing aura on Dragonheart flickered faintly as the Null Origin Tide pressed against it, and for a moment, even Max felt the edge of his forbidden path being worn down by that dreadful wave of nullification.

The clone’s Time Concept also collapsed. Max’s pupils contracted as the temporal ripple that should have delayed Revona shattered the instant the Null Origin Tide touched it. The slowed moment vanished, and the accelerated flow around Max disappeared.
The difference in timing that he had created was erased so completely that even the memory of the advantage felt fragile.
’Even time concept was useless? Do I have to use my time Pseudo Cosmic Path?’

For the first time, genuine shock crossed Max’s eyes. He had expected Revona to resist, and he had expected her to nullify part of the time distortion after noticing the clone. He had not expected her to release a domain-scale nullifying wave that destroyed every layer of his preparation at once.
The black flames thinned, and the hidden clone was forced back into the darkness, its Time Concept fully severed from the battle rhythm.
Revona stood in the center of the pale-gray tide, blood still at the corner of her lips from using Return To Nothing earlier, her face paler than before, and her aura clearly strained.
This new attack had a cost, a heavy one. Her Void Origin Realm trembled around her, and even her eyes showed faint cracks of exhaustion.
But she was still standing, while Max stood before her with nearly all of his power-ups stripped away.
The black-flame domain still enclosed them from the outside world, but inside, its authority had been hollowed until it looked like a dying night sky.
Revona looked at him quietly.
"Your speed is gone."
Max did not answer.
"Your strength is gone."
The pale-gray tide continued pressing forward.
"Your dragon transformation is gone."
Dragonheart trembled slightly in his hand.
"Your flames cannot devour this."
The remaining Emotion Severing Path flickered faintly.
"Even your time concept has been nullified."

Revona lifted her hand, and the remnants of Return To Nothing formed again beside the spreading Null Origin Tide. It was weaker than before, but with Max’s power stripped away, even a weakened Return To Nothing was terrifying enough.
"Accept your defeat, Max Morgan."
The words echoed inside the fading black flames. Outside the Devouring Flames Domain, the entire Divine Realm still could not see what was happening.

They could only watch the black-fire barrier tremble violently, then dim as if something inside had erased its power from within. The spectators grew restless, and the top geniuses on the pillars narrowed their eyes, sensing that the flow of the battle had changed drastically.
Inside the domain, Max looked at Revona in silence. His body felt dry. His divine veins were silent, and the draconic essences no longer answered.

The Dragon Scales Transformation had fully faded, Divine King Punishment had collapsed, and the Devouring Flames Domain was dying. His clone’s Time Concept had failed. Only Dragonheart remained, along with the dulling Emotion Severing Path.
For any other genius, this would have been despair. But Max slowly smiled. It was not a wide smile. It was light, calm, and almost appreciative.
"You are the strongest genius I have ever faced and the only one to push me this far."
Revona’s eyes flickered slightly. Max meant it. Not Damian. Not Ervin. Not Orion. Not Kaiden. Not Rakan. Not Aurelian.

At this moment, with all of his layered powers stripped away by her fully awakened Void Origin Eyes, with his Devouring Flames Domain weakened, with his time strategy broken, and with his body nearly emptied of strength, Max truly acknowledged her.
Revona was the most difficult opponent he had faced so far.
But that didn’t mean he would accept his defeat.
