The laws of the Eternal Hourglass strengthened the barrier around the central arena, as if even it understood that one attack from Damian Voss and one attack from Max Morgan would not be ordinary sword moves.
Damian took a step back and raised his sword before him.
Max also stepped back and held Dragonheart in both hands.
The air between them changed at once.
No one spoke, and no one moved carelessly.
Every spectator, every genius, every elder, and every clan across the Divine Realm fixed their gaze on the stage, because everyone understood one thing.
The next moment would decide everything between these two swordsmen.
The entire Eternal Hourglass became silent after Max and Damian agreed to decide the battle with one sword attack.
This was not a silence born from confusion.
It was the silence of anticipation.
Everyone understood that a normal battle between these two would have been earth-shaking.

Damian Voss had Sword Sovereign Heaven, a terrifying Pseudo Cosmic Path that had already cut through Aurelian’s divine luminance, Kaiden’s Grand Void Labyrinth, Rakan’s War God Body, and many other supreme techniques.
Max Morgan had Dragonheart, the Emotion Severing Path, and a depth of sword comprehension that had only grown more frightening with each battle.
If they fought normally, the clash could have lasted a long time, with both sides revealing layer after layer of strength.
But they had chosen one attack.
One sword.
One collision.
One result.
On the stage, Damian Voss slowly closed his eyes.
The sword in his hand lowered slightly, and the air around him became completely still.
For a few breaths, there was no movement from him at all, yet the entire arena began to feel a sharp pressure spreading outward.
It was not wild, loud, or explosive like lightning or the abyss.
It was the kind of pressure that made every sword in the Divine Realm tremble inside its sheath, because Damian’s entire being seemed to be gathering into one pure edge.
Above and behind him, Sword Sovereign Heaven began to appear.
Sword-edge mountains rose into existence, and rivers of sword light flowed across the sky.
An ancient sword altar stood at the center of that world, while far above it the sword palace appeared with its empty throne.
The single sword hanging before the throne descended slowly, and as it did, all the countless sword lights throughout the Sword Sovereign Heaven bowed toward it.
This was not the First Edict, nor the Second, nor the Third, Fourth, Fifth, or Sixth.
Damian did not intend to hold anything back.
Against Max Morgan, anything less than the strongest attack would be meaningless.
His sword heaven began to collapse inward.
The mountains of swords broke apart and turned into streams of sharp light, and the rivers of sword energy rose into the sky and flowed into the descending sword before the throne.
The sword altar cracked, and the palace trembled.
The empty throne shone with a cold and noble brilliance.
All of Damian’s sword authority, sword heart, sword intent, sword laws, blood, will, and battle experience gathered into the weapon in his hand.
"Sword Sovereign Heaven."
Damian opened his eyes.
"Final Edict."
The single sword before the throne fused into his blade.
"Throne Of The Only Sword."
The moment those words fell, the entire sword world behind him disappeared.
No sword mountains, no sword rivers, no sword palace, and no altar or throne remained.
Only Damian remained, and only his sword remained.
Because only one sword remained, everything else in the arena seemed to lose the right to be called sharp.
Across the Divine Realm, every swordsman felt their heart tremble, and the Sword God Palace fell into complete silence.
This was Damian Voss pushing his strongest sword attack to the absolute limit.

The attack he had used against Ervin had already been terrifying, but now, after experiencing defeat and refining his sword heart through that loss, and after facing Max Morgan directly, Damian’s final edict had become even purer than before.
His sword was no longer merely cutting force, law, rhythm, space, or authority.
It was declaring that beneath this one sword, all other paths would be judged.
Max stood opposite him, and Dragonheart hummed softly in his hand.
The moment Damian’s strongest attack reached its peak, Max’s eyes became serious as well.
He had already seen how terrifying Throne Of The Only Sword was.
If Damian had used this attack against most other geniuses, the battle would have ended instantly.
Even Revona’s Void Origin Eyes would need to treat this sword with caution, because Damian had compressed his entire Pseudo Cosmic Path into one clean and absolute strike.
Max exhaled slowly.
He did not activate Divine King Punishment.
He did not release the Devouring Flames Domain.
He did not use the four Divine Veins, and he did not summon the power of the Dimensional Keeper legacy again.
This was a sword battle, so he would answer with the sword.
Dragonheart rose before him, and a cold, silent aura spread from the blade.
"Emotion Severing Path."
The moment those words left Max’s mouth, the warmth of the arena vanished.
Damian’s sword was pure, proud, sovereign, and absolute.
Max’s sword was quiet, cold, forbidden, and terrifying.
The Emotion Severing Path did not merely carry sharpness.
It carried severance.
It severed feeling, intent, connection, rhythm, authority, and the invisible things that allowed power to remain whole.
The air around Dragonheart became deathly calm, as if every emotion in the battlefield had been cut away before the sword was even swung.
But this time, Max did not stop there.
He closed his eyes for a brief moment, and then the sword technique inherited from the Sword Saint flowed through his body.
"Saint Origin Sword Art."
The moment the name appeared, Dragonheart’s aura changed again, and the cold severing power of the Emotion Severing Path gained structure.
Before this, Max’s Emotion Severing Path had been frightening because of how forbidden and unpredictable it was.
It could sever things that should not be severed, and even top geniuses struggled to understand where the true danger lay.
But now, when Max fused it with the Saint Origin Sword Art, that forbidden severing path gained a sacred sword framework that seemed to arrange every strand of severance into perfect order.
Emotion Severing Path was the edge, and Saint Origin Sword Art was the form.
One was forbidden severance, and the other was the Sword Saint’s order.
When the two merged, the power gathered around Dragonheart became so sharp, so calm, and so complete that even Damian’s eyes changed.
For the first time, a trace of deep admiration appeared in his gaze.

chapters.title: Chapter 1919: The Deadly Confrontation!
paragraphs: "That sword art...," Damian said softly.
Max looked at him. "It belongs to a senior whose sword path deserves utmost respect."
Damian nodded once. "Then I will answer it with everything I have."
Max smiled faintly. "Good."
The two of them moved at the same time. Damian stepped forward, and the entire arena seemed to vanish before his sword.
"Throne Of The Only Sword."

His blade came down. At that moment, every spectator felt as though there was only one sword left in the world. It carried Damian’s full belief, full pride, full defeat, full refinement, and full will.

The sword did not need a storm behind it anymore, because it was the storm. It did not need the sword heaven to support it anymore, because it was the sword heaven condensed into one strike. It cut straight toward Max with the dignity of a sovereign blade that refused to bow before anything.
Max also stepped forward, and Dragonheart descended in his hands.
"Saint Origin Sword Art."
His eyes became calm.
"Emotion Severing Sword."

The blade moved. There was no thunder, no flame, no dragon roar, and no dimensional starlight. Only one sword line remained, a cold, orderly, perfect sword line that carried the full power of the Emotion Severing Path through the structure of the Sword Saint’s technique.

It did not rush to overpower Damian’s sword, and it did not try to crush the Throne Of The Only Sword through greater energy. It moved as though it had already found the invisible thread connecting Damian’s final edict to his sword heart, his sword heaven, his throne, and the singular declaration that only his sword should remain.
The two swords met.
Clang.
The sound was impossibly clear. For one breath, nothing exploded. Damian’s sword pressed forward, and Max’s sword held. Then the stage split beneath them.
Boom!
A ring of sword force erupted outward and slammed into the Eternal Hourglass barrier. Golden laws surged wildly around the arena, layer after layer activating to contain the collision.
The air above the stage was cut into countless invisible fragments, and the ground beneath both swordsmen shattered into deep cracks that stretched from one end of the battlefield to the other.

Damian’s Throne Of The Only Sword pushed with absolute authority. It tried to judge Max’s blade, and it tried to force every other sword path beneath its throne. It tried to cut through the Saint Origin Sword Art and declare Dragonheart inferior to the one sword before it.
But Max’s Emotion Severing Sword did not compete for the throne. It severed the connection that made the throne absolute.
The cold line around Dragonheart slid along Damian’s sword authority, not against the surface of his blade but through the invisible structure behind it.

Saint Origin Sword Art guided the severing power with terrifying precision, preventing the Emotion Severing Path from scattering wildly. Every bit of the forbidden path was placed exactly where it needed to be.

It severed the pride from the pressure. It severed the edict from the throne. It severed the sword heaven’s final support from the single blade, and it severed the meaning of "only sword" from Damian’s attack.
Damian’s pupils contracted, and his sword began to tremble.
"No," someone from the Sword God Palace whispered.
The Throne Of The Only Sword still pressed forward, but its absolute pressure began to crack. The sword itself had not weakened. Damian’s will had not weakened, and his technique had not been flawed.
But Max’s attack was not destroying it from the outside. It was cutting apart the invisible arrangement that allowed all of Damian’s power to exist as one perfect sword.
Crack!
A faint sound echoed through the arena. A line appeared in Damian’s sword light, then a second, then a third.

Damian gritted his teeth and poured everything he had into the final edict. His sword heart burned, and his blood flowed along the blade. The faint image of the empty throne appeared behind him again, trying to stabilize the final attack. But Max’s sword moved one inch deeper.
The Emotion Severing Sword cut through the last connection. The empty throne split, and the final edict broke. The Throne Of The Only Sword shattered.

A blinding storm of broken sword light exploded around them, and for several breaths, no one could see the center of the battlefield. The Eternal Hourglass barrier groaned under the impact, and golden laws descended like chains to suppress the remaining sword force.

Across the Divine Realm, countless swordsmen stared without blinking, their hearts pounding as though they had just watched the highest pride of the sword path collide with something forbidden and divine.

When the light finally faded, Max stood behind Damian, Dragonheart lowered at his side. Damian remained standing in his original position, his sword held forward, but the blade light around it had disappeared.
A thin line of blood appeared at the corner of his mouth, and his sword hand trembled once.
For a moment, Damian said nothing. He simply looked at his sword. The sword itself had not broken, but his strongest attack had.
After a few breaths, Damian closed his eyes.
"You cut through my attack. You win."
Max turned slightly and looked at him. "It wasn’t easy."
Damian opened his eyes again. There was no anger in them, only exhaustion and respect. He looked at Dragonheart, then at Max, and a faint smile appeared on his face for the first time.
"Good sword."
Max smiled lightly. "Yours too."
Damian exhaled. Then he lowered his sword.
"I lose."
Angelina Valerius’s voice descended over the arena.
[Winner: Max Morgan.] [Damian Voss Defeated.]
The screen above the Eternal Hourglass updated.
[Battle Record Updated.] [Max Morgan] [Total Battles Fought: 23] [Total Wins: 23]
[Battle Record Updated.] [Damian Voss] [Total Battles Fought: 23] [Total Wins: 21]
For one long breath, the entire Divine Realm remained silent. Then the eruption came.

The Black Dragon Clan exploded into thunderous cheers. The Sword God Palace stayed silent at first, but soon many disciples clenched their fists with complicated expressions. Damian had lost again, yet there was no shame in this defeat.

He had pushed his strongest attack to its limit. He had refined the Throne Of The Only Sword after losing to Ervin, and he had poured everything into one sword clash, only to still be defeated by Max’s Emotion Severing Sword fused with the Saint Origin Sword Art.
That did not make him weak. It only proved that Max’s sword path had reached a terrifying level.
On the pillars, Orion Starfall released a long breath. "One attack. They really decided it with one attack."
Rakan Thorne shook his head, his expression rare and serious. "If that sword had hit me, I would not even know what was cut."
Kaiden Voidmere looked at Max with deep eyes. "He did not overpower Damian’s sword. He found its source and severed it."
Revona remained silent, but her gaze toward Max became more focused than before.
Ervin watched Damian for a moment, then Max. His abyss-like eyes darkened.

Max had defeated Revona. Max had defeated Damian. And now, only one final unavoidable battle remained between the top undefeated contender before Max and Ervin battle was the battle between Damian and Revona.

chapters.title: Chapter 1920: Damian vs Revona!
paragraphs: The victory screen from Max Morgan’s battle against Damian Voss slowly faded from the sky above the Eternal Hourglass.

The arena remained heavy with the lingering aura of that single sword clash. Even though the stage had already begun restoring itself under the golden laws of the Eternal Hourglass, countless spectators across the Divine Realm were still trapped in the memory of what they had just seen.

Damian had used the strongest sword attack of Sword Sovereign Heaven, pushing Throne Of The Only Sword to its absolute limit, while Max had answered with the Emotion Severing Path fused with the Saint Order Sword Art and severed the invisible connection that made Damian’s final edict absolute.

Damian had lost, but no one could call that defeat humiliating. He had stood as one of the greatest swordsmen of the younger generation and had lost only after using the very peak of his sword path against an even stranger and more terrifying sword.
Angelina Valerius waited until the golden laws repaired the central stage completely before she raised her hand again.
"The second last battle of the Cosmic Ascension Conference will now begin."

The moment those words spread across the Eternal Hourglass, the Divine Realm immediately became tense again. There were only two battles left now. Damian Voss against Revona, then, at last, Max Morgan against Ervin. The champion would be decided after those final results.
The great screen above the arena shifted, and two names appeared.
[Damian Voss] [Revona]
For a moment, the audience fell into a strange silence. Then the entire Divine Realm erupted again.
Sword Sovereign Heaven stood against Void Origin Realm.

The sword that had almost defeated Ervin and had just pushed Max into revealing the Saint Order Sword Art now faced the woman whose Void Origin Eyes had erased Orion’s stars, hollowed Kaiden’s Grand Void Labyrinth, stripped Ervin’s abyss bare, and forced Max to reveal the Dimensional Keeper legacy before she finally fell.
This battle no longer involved undefeated records.
Both had lost.

But that did not reduce the weight of the match at all. If anything, it made it more important in a different way, because this battle would decide who stood higher among the two fallen monsters of the top four.

It would also show whether Damian’s sword, which had nearly reached the peak of singular sword authority, could cut through the terrible Null Origin Tide that had stripped even Ervin of all ability to resist.

On his pillar, Damian slowly stood. His face was still pale from his battle with Max, and the Eternal Hourglass had not fully erased the spiritual exhaustion left behind by forcing Throne Of The Only Sword to its limit.
Even so, his posture remained straight, and his eyes carried no frustration, no hesitation, and no fear. A swordsman could lose, but a true swordsman did not let defeat make his blade dull.
Revona also opened her eyes. Her battle with Ervin had clearly consumed her as well. Her Void Origin Eyes looked calmer now, but beneath that calmness was a deep exhaustion.

She had used Return To Nothing, Null Origin Tide, and several deeper applications of Void Origin Realm in consecutive battles against Max and Ervin. Even someone like her could not continue using such powers without paying a price.
Angelina Valerius looked toward both of them.
"Damian Voss."
"Revona."
"Enter the stage."
Two beams of light descended. Damian appeared on one side of the arena with his sword in hand. Revona appeared opposite him, her pale eyes already open and watching.
For a few breaths, neither of them moved. Damian looked at her calmly and said, "I saw your battle with Max and Ervin, and honestly I don’t know if I could defeat you."
Revona replied quietly, "Your attack against Max was powerful too but I want to see."
Damian’s sword intent rose slowly. "Then we both understand there is no point in delaying."
Revona’s eyes deepened. "Yes."
Angelina raised her hand.
[Battle Begins.]
The moment the battle started, both of them used their strongest power without hesitation.
Damian’s sword rose.
"Sword Sovereign Heaven."
A vast sword world appeared behind him. Sword-edge mountains pierced upward, rivers of sword light flowed across the sky, and the ancient sword altar stood at the center of that world.

Above it, the palace and the empty throne appeared once again, with the single sword hanging before the throne. Even after his previous defeats, even after exhausting himself against Max, the Sword Sovereign Heaven still descended with terrifying majesty.
Revona’s eyes shone.
"Void Origin Realm."
The world behind her became hollow, without sky, ground, sound, or warmth. Only pale-gray emptiness spread behind her, quiet and absolute.

The Void Origin Eyes looked through Damian’s sword world, not merely at the sword lights but at the structure behind them, the edict behind the sword path, the connection between Damian and his Pseudo Cosmic Path, and the foundation that allowed his sword heaven to pressure the battlefield.
The two Pseudo Cosmic Paths clashed immediately. Sword light descended, and void emptiness rose.

The first impact split the stage into silver-white sword scars and pale-gray hollow cracks. Golden laws of the Eternal Hourglass poured down at once, strengthening the barrier because this was not a normal collision.
Damian’s sword did not merely cut, and Revona’s void did not merely defend. Each side was trying to deny the other at the most fundamental level.
Damian attacked first.
"Sword Sovereign Heaven, First Edict, All Blades Refuse Submission."

Countless sword lights descended from above, each one carrying the command of sword sovereignty. They did not scatter loosely across the battlefield. They converged from every angle, each blade-like light aiming for the gaps in Revona’s Void Origin Realm.
Revona lifted one hand.
"Void Origin Eyes."

Half of the sword lights vanished before they touched her, and the other half dimmed, losing their killing intent and falling apart in pale-gray ripples. Yet Damian had already expected that. He stepped forward and raised his sword again.
"Sword Sovereign Heaven, Second Edict, One Sword Divides Heaven."

A single enormous sword line descended from above, splitting through the hollow ripples that had swallowed the first edict. It reached Revona faster than the previous attacks, and because it was condensed into one line, her Void Origin Eyes had to focus more sharply to erase it.

"Sword Sovereign Heaven, Second Edict, One Sword Divides Heaven."
A single enormous sword line descended from above, splitting through the hollow ripples that had swallowed the first edict.
It reached Revona faster than the previous attacks, and because it was condensed into one line, her Void Origin Eyes had to focus more sharply to erase it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1921: Same as Max and Ervin!
paragraphs: Revona’s gaze locked onto the sword line, and it began to vanish. But Damian followed instantly.
"Sword Sovereign Heaven, Third Edict, Blade Meets The Void."

His sword moved through the opening created by the second edict, and a different sword light pierced from beneath the first one. Revona’s eyes shifted, erasing the second sword line halfway, but the remaining sword force cut across her sleeve and drew a thin line of blood from her arm.
The arena stirred. Damian had wounded her early.
The Sword God Palace disciples erupted.
"Senior Brother Damian!"
"He is not giving her time to read everything!"
"He is using strongest attacks one after another!"

Damian did not stop. He knew very well that Revona became more dangerous the longer she watched. If he gave her time to trace the foundation of Sword Sovereign Heaven, then his later attacks would lose their meaning one by one.
So he did what only a swordsman like him could do. He kept attacking with his strongest moves without hesitation.
"Sword Sovereign Heaven, Fourth Edict, Palace Sword Descends."
The palace above the sword altar brightened, and an enormous sword shadow fell from the sky like the judgment of the Sword God Palace itself.
Revona’s Void Origin Realm expanded to meet it, hollowing the outer sword force, but Damian stepped into the pressure and slashed again before the fourth edict fully ended.
"Sword Sovereign Heaven, Fifth Edict, Sword Heart Cannot Be Judged."

His sword heart stabilized. The pale-gray emptiness that tried to dull his sword intent failed to erase it completely. Damian’s blade cut through the hollowing field around Revona and forced her to retreat one step, then a second, then a third.
The Divine Realm went wild.
"He is pushing Revona back!"
"Damian is using edicts continuously!"
"He knows he cannot let her adapt!"
Revona’s eyes remained calm, but her expression had become more serious. Damian appeared before her through a river of sword light.
"Sword Sovereign Heaven, Sixth Edict, Bleeding Sword Severance."

Blood flowed along his sword, and the crimson-white sword light erupted with far more danger than before. It cut through one layer of the Void Origin Realm, then another, forcing Revona to raise both hands to block.

Her Void Origin Eyes shone brightly, tracing the blood sword’s authority, but Damian’s attack was too fierce and too close. The sword line passed through the edge of her defense, and blood appeared at the corner of Revona’s lips.

Damian’s sword did not pause. The empty throne behind him trembled, and his strongest sword intent began gathering again. Revona’s Void Origin Realm cracked around the edges. The spectators across the Divine Realm felt their breathing stop.
For a moment, it truly looked like Damian might push her into a corner before she could use her deepest method.

Damian raised his sword with both hands. The sword heaven behind him began to collapse inward. The mountains dissolved, the rivers vanished, the palace dimmed, and the altar cracked. The single sword before the throne descended again.
"Sword Sovereign Heaven."
Damian’s voice was calm but exhausted.
"Final Edict."
All his remaining sword authority gathered into one blade.
"Throne Of The Only Sword."
The entire battlefield seemed to acknowledge only one sword again. That terrifying attack descended toward Revona.
Revona looked at the incoming sword. Her eyes shone with absolute emptiness.
"Void Origin Realm."
A point of nothingness formed before her palm.
"Return To Nothing."

The two strongest attacks collided. For a breath, the arena lost all sound. The Throne Of The Only Sword tried to cut through the point of origin emptiness, while Return To Nothing tried to erase the absolute sword authority from its foundation.

The sword pressed downward, and the point of nothingness trembled. Revona slid backward, her feet carving deep marks into the stage. Damian’s sword hand bled, and his face became paler, but he continued pressing his final edict forward.
One inch. Then another. The point of Return To Nothing began to crack.
The Sword God Palace disciples shouted madly.
"He is breaking it!"
"Senior Brother Damian is breaking Return To Nothing!"

Revona’s eyes sharpened, and blood slipped down her chin. For the first time, Damian’s sword had pushed her strongest condensed technique close to collapse without relying on hidden tricks, time distortion, dimensional legacy, or layered domains. It was pure sword, pure will, and pure attack.
But Revona still had one more move. The move that had stripped Max bare. The move that had ended Ervin’s forbidden depth technique.
She slowly raised her other hand. Her voice was quiet.
"Void Origin Realm."
The hollow world behind her opened fully.
"Null Origin Tide."
Boom!
A massive pale-gray wave erupted from Revona’s body in every direction, and the Null Origin Tide swallowed the arena. Damian’s sword world was struck first.

The remaining mountains of Sword Sovereign Heaven vanished, the rivers of sword light disappeared, the cracked altar was erased, and the dim sword palace faded. The empty throne trembled violently before losing its shape.
Then the tide reached Damian himself. The sword authority around him dulled, and the Final Edict began losing its foundation.

The blood sword force vanished from his blade, and the sword heart that had resisted judgment was stripped of its external support. The Throne Of The Only Sword, which had been pressing Return To Nothing toward collapse, suddenly lost its absolute pressure.

Damian’s eyes changed. For the first time, he personally felt what Max and Ervin had faced. It was not like being blocked, and it was not like being overpowered. It was like everything that made his power meaningful had been removed.

His sword heaven disappeared, his sword edict disappeared, and his sword aura disappeared. Even the sharpness of the strike in his hand seemed to dry up under the pale-gray tide. Only his physical grip on the sword remained.
The Throne Of The Only Sword shattered.

Revona’s Return To Nothing also collapsed from the strain, but Null Origin Tide continued sweeping outward. Damian stood in the middle of it, his robes torn, his face pale, and his sword lowered slightly as the last traces of Sword Sovereign Heaven disappeared from around him.
He tried to raise his sword again. His wrist moved, but no sword light answered. The Null Origin Tide had stripped it all away.
Across the Divine Realm, the Sword God Palace fell into stunned silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 1922: The final battle!
paragraphs: Damian looked at his sword quietly. Then he looked at Revona. She stood opposite him, pale and bleeding, clearly pushed to the edge by his repeated strongest attacks. Her Void Origin Eyes were exhausted, and her breathing was unsteady.
She had not won easily. Damian had forced her into a corner and nearly broken Return To Nothing with the pure strength of his sword.
But the Null Origin Tide had decided the result.
Damian slowly exhaled. "So this is what they felt."
Revona replied quietly, "You almost broke Return To Nothing."
"But I could not get past the tide."
"No."
Damian closed his eyes for a brief moment. Then he lowered his sword.
"I admit defeat."
Angelina Valerius announced the result immediately.
[Winner: Revona.]
[Damian Voss Defeated.]
The screen above the arena changed.
[Battle Record Updated.] [Revona] [Total Battles Fought: 24] [Total Wins: 23]
[Battle Record Updated.] [Damian Voss] [Total Battles Fought: 24] [Total Wins: 21]
The Divine Realm erupted again, but the reaction was complicated. Revona had won, and Damian had lost.

Yet no one could overlook what had happened. Damian had pushed Revona hard enough that she had been forced to use Return To Nothing and then Null Origin Tide, the same attack that had stripped Max of almost all his powers and defeated Ervin outright.
He had almost cornered her with sword attack after sword attack, and for a moment, the entire Divine Realm had believed his Throne Of The Only Sword might actually break through.
But Revona’s final tide remained too terrifying.
On the pillars, Orion Starfall released a long breath. "That attack is simply unreasonable."
Rakan Thorne frowned. "It strips everything. How are you supposed to fight when your power is gone?"
Kaiden Voidmere looked toward Max. "Only Max had something beyond its reach."
Morgana Starveil’s gaze remained on Revona. "And yet Damian almost forced her down before she used it."

Ervin watched silently. He understood Damian’s defeat better than most, because he had experienced the same thing. There was no shame in losing to Null Origin Tide. The terrifying thing was that Damian had nearly reached Revona before the tide swallowed his sword.

Max Morgan stood quietly on his pillar. His gaze rested on Revona for a moment, then shifted to Damian. Both of them were monsters, and both had reached the end of their strength. Now only one battle remained.
The final battle of the Cosmic Ascension Conference. Max Morgan against Ervin.
The second last battle of the Cosmic Ascension Conference ended with Revona standing victorious over Damian Voss.
Her victory did not come easily. Damian had pushed her to the brink with Sword Sovereign Heaven, forcing her to use Return To Nothing and then Null Origin Tide before he finally admitted defeat.
The Sword God Palace was silent, not because its strongest genius had been humiliated, but because he had shown the full dignity of a swordsman even in defeat.
Revona returned to her pillar pale and exhausted, while Damian stood quietly on his own pillar, his sword lowered at his side and his eyes calm despite another loss.
The records above the arena changed once more.
[Max Morgan] [Total Battles Fought: 23] [Total Wins: 23]
[Revona] [Total Battles Fought: 24] [Total Wins: 23]
[Ervin] [Total Battles Fought: 23] [Total Wins: 22]
[Damian Voss] [Total Battles Fought: 24] [Total Wins: 21]
Only one battle remained. The moment the Divine Realm realized that, the entire atmosphere changed.

The chaotic discussions surrounding Revona’s Null Origin Tide, Damian’s final sword, and Ervin’s earlier defeat slowly faded into one heavy, boiling silence. Countless eyes turned toward the two remaining pillars.

On one side stood Max Morgan, the white-haired genius of the Black Dragon Clan, the man who had defeated Revona, Damian, Orion, Kaiden, Rakan, Aurelian, Rosaline, and every other opponent placed before him.

On the other side stood Ervin, the abyssal spear wielder who had defeated Damian by the smallest margin and had only fallen to Revona after she used the same terrifying Null Origin Tide that had almost stripped Max bare.
One was still undefeated. The other had lost once, but no one dared to treat him as lesser.

Angelina Valerius stood above the restored central arena, her silver-white robe moving gently even though no wind existed in the Eternal Hourglass. Her pale golden hair shone beneath the golden laws surrounding the stage, and when she raised her hand, the entire Divine Realm quieted at once.
"The final battle of the Cosmic Ascension Conference will now begin."
Her voice spread through every viewing formation, every ancient hall, every clan square, every sect pavilion, every hidden space, and every battlefield projection across the Divine Realm.
The screen above the arena flashed.
[Final Battle] [Max Morgan vs Ervin]
The moment those two names appeared together, the Divine Realm erupted with a roar that seemed capable of shaking the heavens.

The Black Dragon Clan exploded first. Countless disciples stood from their seats, shouting Max’s name with faces flushed from excitement. Elders who had been trying to maintain dignity for the entire conference finally failed to hide the trembling in their eyes.

Lady Virelia watched the screen with a proud and solemn expression, while Mathew Grimes and the other family heads stared as though they were witnessing the birth of something that might reshape the entire Divine Realm’s younger generation.
"He reached the final battle undefeated!"
"Max Morgan is one victory away from the championship!"
"If he defeats Ervin, he will stand above every genius in this conference!"

Across the Sword God Palace, the Nine Star Court, the Grand Void Sanctum, the War God Palace, the Stellar Templar, the elven factions, the hidden clans, and countless ancient forces, no one looked away.

Even those who had once mocked Max for his background, his origins, or his connection to the Black Dragon Clan now watched him with heavy expressions. A genius who could reach this point could no longer be dismissed by anyone.
At the same time, countless gazes also gathered on Ervin. He was not the undefeated one now, and he was not the statistical favorite.

But after his battle against Damian, after his forbidden technique against Revona, and after the terrifying depth of Abyssal Origin Descent had been revealed again and again, no one believed he had no chance.
If there was anyone remaining who could still force Max into danger, it was Ervin.

On the pillars, the top geniuses became silent. Revona opened her pale eyes and looked toward Max first, then toward Ervin. She had fought both of them and understood the danger of each more clearly than anyone else.

Damian Voss stood with his arms lowered, his sword sheathed, but his gaze was sharp and focused. Orion Starfall leaned forward with a bright smile, unable to hide the excitement in his eyes. Rakan Thorne grinned with battle hunger, while Kaiden Voidmere’s gaze became deep and still.
Angelina looked toward the two remaining contenders.
"Max Morgan."
"Ervin."
"Enter the stage."

chapters.title: Chapter 1923: Ervin’s Thoughts!
paragraphs: Two beams of golden light descended. Max appeared on one side of the central arena with Dragonheart at his waist, his white hair falling calmly over his shoulders and his expression unreadable.
Ervin appeared opposite him with his black spear in hand. His body had been mostly repaired by the Eternal Hourglass, but the exhaustion in his aura had not fully disappeared.

After fighting Damian to the brink and then breaking himself against Revona’s Null Origin Tide, even someone like Ervin could not return to perfect condition so quickly. Yet his eyes were still deep, steady, and abyss-like, as if the broken gate behind him had only sunk deeper after every defeat and victory.
For a few breaths, neither spoke. The Divine Realm watched in complete silence.
Then Ervin looked at Max and smiled wryly. "It seems the final battle has become strange."
Max raised an eyebrow slightly. "Strange?"

Ervin glanced at the screen above them, where the records still shone clearly. "You have twenty-three victories and no defeats. I have twenty-two victories and one defeat. Even if I defeat you here, both of us will have one defeat, and both of us will stand at twenty-three victories."
The spectators quieted even further as they realized what he meant.
Ervin shook his head lightly. "In other words, even if I win, I will not truly become champion outright. The conference will end in a draw between us."

The words spread across the arena and immediately caused waves of discussion throughout the Divine Realm. Many people had been so caught up in the excitement of the final battle that they had not fully calculated the result.

Max had defeated Revona and Damian, while Ervin had defeated Damian but lost to Revona. If Ervin defeated Max now, his record would become twenty-three wins and one defeat, and Max’s record would also become twenty-three wins and one defeat.
In that case, unless Angelina or the Eternal Hourglass introduced another tiebreaker, the top of the conference would indeed become a draw.
In fact, even Revona had only one loss here, and that came against Max. So if Max were to lose against Ervin here, it would become a three-way tie between him, Ervin, and Revona.
But if Max won, then there would be no argument. He would finish with twenty-four victories and no defeats. Absolute champion.
The pressure of the final battle became even heavier.
Max looked at Ervin and smiled faintly. "Then you should make sure I win."
Ervin’s wry smile deepened. "If only you can force me to."
He paused for a moment, then his gaze became more curious. "Before that, I do have one question."
Max looked at him calmly. "Ask."
Ervin’s eyes narrowed slightly, but there was no hostility in them, only genuine interest. "How did you defeat Revona after she stripped away your powers?"
The entire arena became quieter. Even Revona’s gaze sharpened slightly from her pillar.

That question had been sitting in the hearts of countless spectators since Max’s battle against Revona. They had seen Revona use Null Origin Tide, and they had seen how it stripped Max of his powers before doing the same to Ervin and Damian.

Ervin had fallen once his abyss was erased, and Damian had been forced to admit defeat once his sword heaven was stripped away. Yet Max had somehow risen from that exact state and cut through Revona’s final defense.
What power had he used? What was that star-like radiance? What kind of legacy could remain beyond Revona’s nullification?
Max smiled. "It is a secret."
Ervin stared at him for a breath. Then he laughed softly. It was not loud, but it was the first time many people had seen Ervin smile so openly.
"I expected that answer."
He then lifted his black spear slowly, and the air around him began to sink.
"Regardless of anything, let us have a good battle."
Max’s hand moved to Dragonheart’s hilt.
"Agreed."
The atmosphere between them changed instantly. The light conversation faded, and the final battle truly began to take shape.

Ervin’s abyssal aura deepened, and beneath his feet, the faint shadow of a black sea began to spread. It was quieter than before, but more condensed. The broken gate did not appear yet, but its presence could already be felt somewhere deep below the battlefield, waiting to rise from the darkness.

Max’s sword aura also began to awaken. Dragonheart hummed faintly, and a cold, silent edge spread from him, brushing against the air like a blade that had not yet been drawn but had already severed the tension around it.
Angelina Valerius looked at them both, and for a rare moment, even she seemed to pause.
It was not hesitation, and it was not uncertainty. It was more like acknowledgement.
Even someone of her status, someone carrying the dignity of the hidden Valerius clan and acting under the recognition of the Eternal Hourglass itself, could feel the weight of this final battle.

Max Morgan had reached this point without a single defeat, cutting down every opponent placed before him, while Ervin stood opposite him with one defeat on his record but an abyssal spear path deep enough to terrify every genius who had faced it.
Their records were different, but their presence on the stage made it impossible for anyone to treat this as a simple final match.

The laws of the Eternal Hourglass brightened around the arena. Golden threads spread across the barrier like countless ancient seals preparing to contain a disaster. The restored stage beneath Max and Ervin became silent, yet that silence carried a pressure heavier than any roar.
On one side, Dragonheart gave a faint hum from Max’s hand, as though the sword itself understood that the last obstacle before the championship had appeared.
On the other side, Ervin’s black spear rested quietly in his grip, while the shadow beneath his feet deepened like a sea waiting for the first crack in the world.
Angelina’s gaze moved once across the stage, then across the pillars where Revona, Damian, Orion, Kaiden, Rakan, Morgana, and the other geniuses watched without blinking.
After that, her eyes lifted toward the countless viewing formations connected to the Divine Realm.
Then her hand descended.
[Final Battle Begins.]
The moment those words appeared, no one cheered. The entire Divine Realm held its breath.

Max Morgan against Ervin. The undefeated white-haired swordsman against the abyssal spear wielder. One carried Dragonheart, the Emotion Severing Path, and layers of power that had broken through even Revona’s final nullification.

The other carried Abyssal Origin Descent, the broken gate, and a spear path that had defeated Damian Voss by the smallest possible margin before forcing Revona to reveal everything. This was no longer only a clash between sword and spear.
It was the final collision between two monsters who had walked through the strongest geniuses of the conference and still remained standing at the end.
One battle would decide everything. If Max won, the Cosmic Ascension Conference would end with an absolute champion, a perfect record, and a name that no force in the Divine Realm could ignore again.

If Ervin won, Max’s undefeated record would be broken, Ervin would stand equal to him in total victories, and the conference would end in a draw between two terrifying existences who had both reached the summit from different paths.
The pressure was so heavy that even the top geniuses on the pillars forgot to breathe for a moment.
The final battle had begun.

sentences.text: Two beams of golden light descended.
Max appeared on one side of the central arena with Dragonheart at his waist, his white hair falling calmly over his shoulders and his expression unreadable.
Ervin appeared opposite him with his black spear in hand.
His body had been mostly repaired by the Eternal Hourglass, but the exhaustion in his aura had not fully disappeared.
After fighting Damian to the brink and then breaking himself against Revona’s Null Origin Tide, even someone like Ervin could not return to perfect condition so quickly.
Yet his eyes were still deep, steady, and abyss-like, as if the broken gate behind him had only sunk deeper after every defeat and victory.
For a few breaths, neither spoke.
The Divine Realm watched in complete silence.
Then Ervin looked at Max and smiled wryly.
"It seems the final battle has become strange."
Max raised an eyebrow slightly.
"Strange?"
Ervin glanced at the screen above them, where the records still shone clearly.
"You have twenty-three victories and no defeats.
I have twenty-two victories and one defeat.
Even if I defeat you here, both of us will have one defeat, and both of us will stand at twenty-three victories."
The spectators quieted even further as they realized what he meant.
Ervin shook his head lightly.
"In other words, even if I win, I will not truly become champion outright.
The conference will end in a draw between us."
The words spread across the arena and immediately caused waves of discussion throughout the Divine Realm.
Many people had been so caught up in the excitement of the final battle that they had not fully calculated the result.
Max had defeated Revona and Damian, while Ervin had defeated Damian but lost to Revona.
If Ervin defeated Max now, his record would become twenty-three wins and one defeat, and Max’s record would also become twenty-three wins and one defeat.
In that case, unless Angelina or the Eternal Hourglass introduced another tiebreaker, the top of the conference would indeed become a draw.
In fact, even Revona had only one loss here, and that came against Max.
So if Max were to lose against Ervin here, it would become a three-way tie between him, Ervin, and Revona.
But if Max won, then there would be no argument.
He would finish with twenty-four victories and no defeats.
Absolute champion.
The pressure of the final battle became even heavier.
Max looked at Ervin and smiled faintly.
"Then you should make sure I win."
Ervin’s wry smile deepened.
"If only you can force me to."
He paused for a moment, then his gaze became more curious.
"Before that, I do have one question."
Max looked at him calmly.
"Ask."
Ervin’s eyes narrowed slightly, but there was no hostility in them, only genuine interest.
"How did you defeat Revona after she stripped away your powers?"
The entire arena became quieter.
Even Revona’s gaze sharpened slightly from her pillar.
That question had been sitting in the hearts of countless spectators since Max’s battle against Revona.
They had seen Revona use Null Origin Tide, and they had seen how it stripped Max of his powers before doing the same to Ervin and Damian.
Ervin had fallen once his abyss was erased, and Damian had been forced to admit defeat once his sword heaven was stripped away.
Yet Max had somehow risen from that exact state and cut through Revona’s final defense.
What power had he used?
What was that star-like radiance?
What kind of legacy could remain beyond Revona’s nullification?
Max smiled.
"It is a secret."
Ervin stared at him for a breath.
Then he laughed softly.
It was not loud, but it was the first time many people had seen Ervin smile so openly.
"I expected that answer."
He then lifted his black spear slowly, and the air around him began to sink.
"Regardless of anything, let us have a good battle."
Max’s hand moved to Dragonheart’s hilt.
"Agreed."
The atmosphere between them changed instantly.
The light conversation faded, and the final battle truly began to take shape.
Ervin’s abyssal aura deepened, and beneath his feet, the faint shadow of a black sea began to spread.
It was quieter than before, but more condensed.
The broken gate did not appear yet, but its presence could already be felt somewhere deep below the battlefield, waiting to rise from the darkness.
Max’s sword aura also began to awaken.
Dragonheart hummed faintly, and a cold, silent edge spread from him, brushing against the air like a blade that had not yet been drawn but had already severed the tension around it.
Angelina Valerius looked at them both, and for a rare moment, even she seemed to pause.
It was not hesitation, and it was not uncertainty.
It was more like acknowledgement.
Even someone of her status, someone carrying the dignity of the hidden Valerius clan and acting under the recognition of the Eternal Hourglass itself, could feel the weight of this final battle.

Max Morgan had reached this point without a single defeat, cutting down every opponent placed before him, while Ervin stood opposite him with one defeat on his record but an abyssal spear path deep enough to terrify every genius who had faced it.

The laws of the Eternal Hourglass brightened around the arena.
Golden threads spread across the barrier like countless ancient seals preparing to contain a disaster.

chapters.title: Chapter 1924: Using Full Strength!
paragraphs: The moment the final battle began, neither Max nor Ervin moved recklessly.
They stood on opposite sides of the arena, watching each other through the heavy silence that had fallen over the Eternal Hourglass.
After all the battles they had seen and fought, both of them understood one simple truth. There was no longer any need for shallow testing.
Ervin had watched Max defeat Revona, Damian, Orion, Kaiden, Aurelian, and Rakan, along with every other opponent placed before him.
Max had watched Ervin defeat Damian by the smallest margin and push Revona to the point where she had been forced to use Return To Nothing and Null Origin Tide.
Neither of them was an unknown opponent, and neither was weak enough to be handled with half-hearted attacks.
The first movement came from Max. His hand tightened around Dragonheart. Then the four Divine Veins opened inside his body.
"Vein of Origin."
"Vein of Vitality."
"Vein of Speed."
"Vein of Strength."
Boom!
A terrifying pressure erupted from Max’s body and shook the entire stage.

The Vein of Origin opened the deepest foundation of his power and made his aura suddenly feel vast, stable, and ancient, as if every technique he released would be supported by an origin that refused to collapse.

The Vein of Vitality filled his body with monstrous life force, causing his blood, bones, muscles, and spirit to surge with relentless endurance. The Vein of Speed sharpened his movement until his body seemed prepared to vanish at any instant, while the Vein of Strength poured a crushing physical force into his limbs that made the ground beneath his feet crack outward in a wide circle.

The audience had seen these four Divine Veins before, but even now, when they appeared together again, the shock they caused did not lessen. Max had already proved against Revona that these veins were not ordinary bodily enhancements.
When they worked together, his physical body became a weapon that could pressure even a fully awakened Void Origin Eyes user.
Now, with Dragonheart in his hand and Ervin standing before him, those same four Divine Veins made Max’s presence feel like a storm contained inside a human body.
But Max did not stop there.
Seven-colored lightning appeared above him. At first, it was only a faint crackle. Then the sky above the arena split open with a violent roar.
A throne of seven-colored lightning appeared in the storm, and behind it, a vast thunder tribunal formed like an ancient judgment hall descending from the heavens.

The lightning did not feel like ordinary destructive power. It carried verdict, punishment, authority, and divine wrath. Every arc of lightning seemed to be waiting for Max’s will, as if the entire storm existed to punish whatever opponent stood before him.
"Pseudo Cosmic Path."
"Divine King Punishment."
The seven-colored lightning roared. Then Dragonheart released a colder sound. The warmth around Max disappeared, and a silent, forbidden aura spread along the blade.
The invisible things in the air seemed to tremble before it, since killing intent, battle rhythm, technique connection, authority, and certainty all became fragile beneath that sword aura.
"Emotion Severing Path."
The moment Max released both Pseudo Cosmic Paths, the atmosphere in the arena changed completely. On one side, Divine King Punishment hung above him like a heavenly verdict ready to descend.

On the other, Emotion Severing Path rested on Dragonheart like a forbidden edge capable of cutting the invisible support behind any technique. Between them stood Max’s body, strengthened by the four Divine Veins. The combination was terrifying.
Ervin watched it all calmly, but the abyss in his eyes grew deeper.
"So you are starting seriously."
Max looked at him and said, "You are not someone I can afford to test slowly."
Ervin smiled faintly.
"Good."
He planted the end of his black spear into the stage, and the ground beneath him darkened.
"Abyssal Origin Descent."
The black sea rose, spreading outward from beneath Ervin’s feet and covering half the arena in an instant. The water was not water in the ordinary sense.

It was depth given form, darkness given weight, and silence given motion. Every wave carried the feeling of something sinking forever, and every ripple seemed connected to a place so deep that light, sound, and direction could not return from it.
Then the broken gate emerged. It rose from the black sea, enormous and ancient, half-submerged behind Ervin, covered in unreadable symbols that flickered like dying stars beneath the abyss.
The moment it appeared, the arena seemed to tilt downward toward Ervin, as if the world itself had found a lower point and wanted to fall into it.
"Gate of the First Depth."
The gate opened, and a heavy abyssal pressure surged across the stage.
Ervin lifted his spear. "I will not hold back."
Max smiled faintly. "That is better."
Ervin moved first.
"Abyss Spear Art, Hollow Descent Thrust."
His spear pierced forward, and the black sea behind him followed the tip like a sinking world. The attack did not travel in a straight line.
It dropped through depth, vanished from the surface of the battlefield, and reappeared directly before Max’s chest with a pressure that could drag his body and sword into the abyss at the same time.
Max stepped forward. The Vein of Speed flashed, and Dragonheart moved.
"Emotion Severing Sword."
His blade cut across the path of the spear.
Clang!

The first collision erupted with terrifying force. The abyssal thrust tried to pull Dragonheart downward, but the Emotion Severing Path cut through the connection between the spear force and the depth behind it.
At the same time, Max’s Vein of Strength erupted through his arm, and the sheer physical power behind his sword forced Ervin’s spear to bend slightly to the side.
Ervin’s eyes narrowed. Max did not stop. Seven-colored lightning descended from above.
"Divine King Punishment, Thunder Verdict."
A pillar of seven-colored lightning slammed toward Ervin’s head.
Ervin spun his spear immediately.
"Abyss Spear Art, Hollow Moon Guard."
A crescent-shaped abyssal shield rose before him, swallowing the first layer of lightning. But Divine King Punishment did not act like ordinary thunder.
The moment its first layer was swallowed, the second layer detonated inside the abyssal guard, causing seven-colored arcs to burst through the darkness.
Ervin slid back. Max appeared before him at the same instant. The Vein of Speed made his movement almost impossible to follow, and the Vein of Strength carried Dragonheart down with brutal force.
Clang!
Spear and sword collided again, and this time Ervin was forced back three steps.
The Divine Realm erupted.
"Max has the advantage!"
"Ervin’s abyss swallowed part of the lightning, but Max’s sword severed the depth connection!"
"He is attacking with body, lightning, and sword path at the same time!"
"That combination is too much!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1925: Sever The Descent!
paragraphs: Ervin’s expression remained calm, but his arm had clearly trembled from the last collision. Max’s physical strength was different from Damian’s sword pressure and Revona’s nullification. Damian’s attacks were sharp and absolute, and Revona’s attacks erased and hollowed.

Max, however, brought too many different kinds of danger at once. His body struck like a dragon, his lightning punished from above, and his sword severed the hidden structure behind Ervin’s abyss. Every time Ervin blocked one layer, another layer followed immediately.
Ervin stepped deeper into the black sea.
"Abyssal Origin Descent, First Depth Tide."
The sea rose in a massive wave and charged toward Max from the front, while two hidden currents curved behind him from both sides.
Max did not retreat. The Vein of Origin stabilized his foundation, the Vein of Vitality surged through his body, and the Vein of Strength roared in his arm. Then he slashed.
"Emotion Severing Path, Severing Current."

Dragonheart cut through the front wave, and the visible black sea split apart. But the two hidden currents still arrived from behind. Before they could strike his back, the thunder tribunal above him roared again.
"Divine King Punishment, Sevenfold Trial."
Seven bolts of lightning descended at once. Three struck the hidden current on the left, and three struck the hidden current on the right. The final bolt struck directly toward Ervin.
Ervin raised his spear and thrust upward.
"Abyss Spear Art, Deep Current Reversal."
The black sea twisted around his spear and absorbed the final lightning bolt before reversing part of its force back toward Max.
But Max had already vanished from his original position. The Vein of Speed carried him through the gap between two crashing waves, and in the next instant, he appeared at Ervin’s right side.
His fist moved before his sword.
Boom!
The punch landed against Ervin’s spear shaft. It was only a punch, but it carried the Vein of Strength. The spear shaft slammed into Ervin’s chest, and the impact drove him backward across the stage.
The black sea beneath him erupted to slow his retreat, but Max’s seven-colored lightning crashed down again, striking the sea and forcing the abyssal water to scatter.
Ervin coughed softly, and a trace of blood appeared at the corner of his mouth.
Across the pillars, the geniuses became even more serious.
Damian Voss looked at the stage and said quietly, "He is not giving Ervin time to deepen the gate."
Kaiden Voidmere nodded. "That is the correct choice. If the abyss is allowed to settle, every attack becomes harder to finish."
Revona watched Max with pale, sharp eyes. "He is attacking the rhythm, not only Ervin."
Rakan Thorne grinned. "And his body is absurd."
On the stage, Ervin wiped the blood from his lips with the back of his hand.
"You are faster than before."
Max held Dragonheart calmly. "You have seen my fights. I cannot surprise you with something ordinary."
Ervin’s smile deepened slightly. "Then I will go deeper."
The Gate of the First Depth trembled, then it opened wider.
"Abyssal Origin Descent."
The pressure of the black sea increased.
"Gate of the Second Depth."
Boom!

The stage sank under a far heavier force. The black sea turned denser, and the darkness beyond the broken gate became so deep that even the light of Divine King Punishment dimmed slightly near its edge.
This was the same gate that had pushed Damian to the brink and allowed Ervin to unleash attacks powerful enough to threaten the strongest geniuses of the conference.
Max’s eyes sharpened. The battle had truly started now.
Ervin raised his spear with both hands.
"Second Depth Spear."
The black sea gathered around the spear tip, forming a sinking world of darkness.
"Sunken World."

He thrust forward, and a terrifying force surged toward Max. It did not merely attack his body. It tried to make his entire position sink. The ground, air, sword aura, lightning path, and even the space around him seemed to descend toward the Second Depth.
If this attack struck cleanly, Max’s momentum would collapse, and Ervin would drag the rhythm of the battle into his own abyssal world.

Max stepped forward again. The Vein of Origin shone within him, the Vein of Vitality roared, the Vein of Speed accelerated his body, and the Vein of Strength gathered into Dragonheart. Above him, Divine King Punishment descended, and around his sword, the Emotion Severing Path condensed.
"Divine King Punishment, Heavenly Verdict Descent."
Seven-colored lightning crashed into the front of Sunken World. At the same time, Max swung Dragonheart.
"Emotion Severing Sword."

The sword line cut into the sinking world. The abyssal force pressed forward with frightening power. Divine King Punishment destroyed layer after layer of the outer depth, while Emotion Severing Path cut into the connection between the spear and the Second Depth behind it.
Max’s body still felt the sinking pressure, but the four Divine Veins held him in place.

The Vein of Vitality prevented the pressure from crushing his internal flow. The Vein of Origin prevented the abyss from disturbing his foundation, and the Vein of Strength allowed him to keep pushing forward with terrifying physical force.

For several breaths, Sunken World and Max’s combined attack clashed violently. Then Max took one step. The stage cracked. He took another, and Ervin’s spear trembled. A third step, and Sunken World split.
Ervin’s eyes changed. Max broke through the front of the attack and arrived before him, Dragonheart descending with lightning wrapped around its edge.
Ervin raised his spear.
Clang!

The impact forced Ervin’s knees to bend slightly. The black sea behind him surged to support him, but Max’s Emotion Severing Path cut the support halfway, and Divine King Punishment struck the sea from above, weakening it further.
Max leaned forward slightly. His voice was calm.
"You cannot block me like this."
Ervin’s gaze deepened. "I know."
The broken gate behind him groaned. He twisted his spear and released a sudden inward pull.
"Abyssal Origin Descent, Return To Depth."

A whirlpool opened beneath Max’s feet, and the abyss tried to drag him downward. Max’s body sank slightly for the first time, but he did not panic. His Vein of Strength erupted again, and he stomped the ground with terrifying force.
The stage cracked outward. At the same time, Dragonheart stabbed downward.
"Emotion Severing Path, Sever The Descent."

It tried to make his entire position sink.
The ground, air, sword aura, lightning path, and even the space around him seemed to descend toward the Second Depth.
If this attack struck cleanly, Max’s momentum would collapse, and Ervin would drag the rhythm of the battle into his own abyssal world.
Max stepped forward again.
The Vein of Origin shone within him, the Vein of Vitality roared, the Vein of Speed accelerated his body, and the Vein of Strength gathered into Dragonheart.
Above him, Divine King Punishment descended, and around his sword, the Emotion Severing Path condensed.
"Divine King Punishment, Heavenly Verdict Descent."
Seven-colored lightning crashed into the front of Sunken World.
At the same time, Max swung Dragonheart.
"Emotion Severing Sword."
The sword line cut into the sinking world.
The abyssal force pressed forward with frightening power.
Divine King Punishment destroyed layer after layer of the outer depth, while Emotion Severing Path cut into the connection between the spear and the Second Depth behind it.
Max’s body still felt the sinking pressure, but the four Divine Veins held him in place.
The Vein of Vitality prevented the pressure from crushing his internal flow.
The Vein of Origin prevented the abyss from disturbing his foundation, and the Vein of Strength allowed him to keep pushing forward with terrifying physical force.
For several breaths, Sunken World and Max’s combined attack clashed violently.
Then Max took one step.
The stage cracked.
He took another, and Ervin’s spear trembled.
A third step, and Sunken World split.
Ervin’s eyes changed.
Max broke through the front of the attack and arrived before him, Dragonheart descending with lightning wrapped around its edge.
Ervin raised his spear.
Clang!
The impact forced Ervin’s knees to bend slightly.
The black sea behind him surged to support him, but Max’s Emotion Severing Path cut the support halfway, and Divine King Punishment struck the sea from above, weakening it further.
Max leaned forward slightly.
His voice was calm.
"You cannot block me like this."
Ervin’s gaze deepened.
"I know."
The broken gate behind him groaned.
He twisted his spear and released a sudden inward pull.
"Abyssal Origin Descent, Return To Depth."
A whirlpool opened beneath Max’s feet, and the abyss tried to drag him downward.
Max’s body sank slightly for the first time, but he did not panic.
His Vein of Strength erupted again, and he stomped the ground with terrifying force.
The stage cracked outward.
At the same time, Dragonheart stabbed downward.
"Emotion Severing Path, Sever The Descent."

chapters.title: Chapter 1926: This is my strongest attack!
paragraphs: The sword pierced into the edge of the whirlpool, and the invisible connection pulling Max toward the Second Depth was cut. The whirlpool collapsed.
Ervin used that brief moment to retreat, but Max followed immediately with the Vein of Speed. His movement was too fast, too direct, and too violent.
In close combat, Ervin’s spear was profound, and his technique carried incredible depth, but Max’s body had become too overwhelming with the four Divine Veins activated.
Every sword strike carried the strength of a body refiner. Every step crossed distance like lightning. Every collision threatened to tear Ervin’s guard apart.
"Abyss Spear Art, Gate Shadow Thrust."
Ervin’s spear stabbed from the shadow of the broken gate.
Max turned Dragonheart sideways and blocked.
Clang!
"Divine King Punishment, Judgment Chain."
Seven-colored lightning wrapped around the spear shaft. Ervin released abyssal depth to swallow it, but the Emotion Severing Path on Dragonheart flashed again and cut at the rhythm of his release.
The chain of lightning tightened for a fraction of a breath, and that was enough for Max to step in and slam his shoulder into Ervin’s chest.
Boom!
Ervin was blasted backward, and blood spilled from his mouth. The Gate of the Second Depth shook behind him.
The Divine Realm was boiling now.
"Max is suppressing him!"
"Ervin opened the Second Depth, but Max still has the upper hand!"
"His body is too strong, and those two Pseudo Cosmic Paths are attacking different weaknesses!"
"Divine King Punishment breaks the outer abyss, while Emotion Severing Path cuts the hidden connections!"
"How is Ervin supposed to defend against all that while also dealing with Max’s physical strength?"
Ervin landed near the edge of the arena, one knee bending slightly before he forced himself back up. The black spear in his hand trembled. His eyes remained calm, but his breathing had grown heavier.

Max stood at the center of the battlefield, Dragonheart in hand, seven-colored lightning roaring above him, Emotion Severing Path spreading from his sword, and the four Divine Veins blazing through his body like divine channels of ancient power.

At that moment, even the top geniuses had to admit one thing. In direct clashes, Max had the upper hand. Ervin’s abyss was deep, his spear was terrifying, and his Pseudo Cosmic Path was worthy of standing near the top of the entire conference.

But Max’s physical strength, supported by the four Divine Veins and reinforced by the simultaneous pressure of Divine King Punishment and Emotion Severing Path, was too much for him to handle in straightforward exchanges.
Ervin slowly exhaled. Then he smiled faintly despite the blood on his lips.
"As expected, I cannot beat you head-on."
Max looked at him calmly. "You knew that already."
"I did."
The broken gate behind Ervin became darker, and the black sea beneath him sank again. His smile faded, and his eyes became abyssal.
"That is why I will have to use something else."

The moment Ervin said those words, the black sea beneath him stopped moving. It did not calm. It became dead still. The entire Abyssal Origin Descent behind him changed in a way that made even the top geniuses on the pillars feel their expressions tighten.
The Gate of the Second Depth, which had already opened earlier, trembled as though something behind it was pushing against its ancient frame.
The unreadable symbols carved across the broken gate began bleeding black light, and every drop that fell into the sea below caused the stage to sink with a dull, oppressive rumble.
Max watched quietly.

Ervin lifted his spear with both hands. His fingers were already bleeding. The previous forbidden art he had used against Revona had nearly broken his body, but this one was different. The aura coming from him did not merely strain his flesh. It began destroying him from within the moment he summoned it.

Cracks appeared across his arms first, thin and dark, as if abyssal pressure had carved itself beneath his skin. Then those cracks spread to his shoulders, chest, neck, and face. Blood flowed from them, but it did not fall normally.
The blood sank into the air, swallowed by the abyss before it could touch the ground.
The Divine Realm became silent. Everyone could see what was happening. Ervin was burning his body as the price for one final spear.
Revona’s pale eyes narrowed from her pillar. She had forced Ervin into a similar state before, but even she could tell that this technique was beyond what he had used against her.
Damian Voss silently gripped the hilt of his sword, his gaze becoming solemn.

Orion Starfall’s smile disappeared for the first time in a long while, while Rakan Thorne’s battle-crazed expression became heavy. Kaiden Voidmere stared at the broken gate with deep eyes, as if he could feel the space around the arena becoming unable to escape the pull of the abyss.
Angelina Valerius looked down at the battlefield, her eyes calm but sharper than before. The golden laws of the Eternal Hourglass began brightening even before Ervin attacked.
Ervin coughed blood. His knees bent slightly, but he did not fall. Instead, he smiled. It was not a wry smile this time. It was a clear one.
"Max Morgan," he said, his voice hoarse but steady, "this attack will destroy my body if the Eternal Hourglass does not repair me afterward."
Max looked at him silently.
Ervin raised his spear higher. "But if I do not use it here, then there is no meaning in standing in this final battle."

The broken gate behind him opened again, not wider but deeper. A third layer did not appear as a visible gate but as a dark absence beyond the second gate, a depth so heavy that even the black sea seemed afraid to fall into it.

The moment that depth appeared, Ervin’s body cracked further. His bones groaned, and his blood vessels burst beneath his skin. The abyssal pressure around him became so dense that the arena floor beneath his feet began to cave downward, even though the Eternal Hourglass laws were continuously repairing it.
"Abyssal Origin Descent."
Ervin’s spear shook.
"Forbidden Final Depth Art."
The black sea rose behind him, then collapsed into the spear. The broken gate bent inward, and the darkness beyond it poured into the spear tip like the last shadow of a dying world.
"Body-Burying Abyss Spear."

The moment the name fell, Ervin’s aura disappeared from the surface of the battlefield. Then it returned from below. Not from below the stage, but from below existence. The spear in his hand no longer looked like a weapon. It looked like a black line connected to a place where all worlds sank after their end.

The attack had not yet been released, but everyone could feel that if it landed, it would not simply pierce flesh or destroy defense. It would bury the body, the power, the movement, the will, and the battlefield itself under a depth that Ervin’s current body was never meant to carry.
His skin split further. Blood poured from him, and even his black spear began to crack. Yet his eyes remained fixed on Max.
"This is my strongest attack."

chapters.title: Chapter 1927: The Winner!
paragraphs: Max’s expression did not change. He did not mock him, and he did not praise him loudly. He only tightened his grip around Dragonheart.
Then the 5000 Dragon Essences inside his body awakened. All at once.
Boom!

A roar that sounded like thousands of dragons rising from an ancient battlefield exploded from Max’s body. The four Divine Veins were already burning inside him, but the moment the full power of the 5000 Dragon Essences surged through his flesh, blood, and bones, the pressure around him changed completely.
His body no longer felt like that of a swordsman strengthened by divine veins alone. It felt like a human-shaped dragon monarch standing beneath a storm of seven-colored heavenly punishment.
Black dragon scales spread across his skin.
"Dragon Scales Transformation."

The scales emerged layer by layer, each one dense, sharp, and filled with chaotic draconic pressure. His shoulders widened slightly, his pupils sharpened, and the air around his body cracked under the sudden rise of raw physical force.
The Vein of Origin stabilized the violent power.
The Vein of Vitality kept his body from being torn apart by the surge.
The Vein of Speed sharpened every muscle and nerve, and the Vein of Strength fused with the 5000 Dragon Essences, pushing his physical power to a level beyond what he had shown earlier in the battle.
Above him, Divine King Punishment roared, and the seven-colored lightning throne brightened until it looked like a divine court judging the final spear of the abyss.
Dragonheart began to hum. The Emotion Severing Path spread over the blade again, colder than ever before. Then Max added the sword technique that had defeated Damian’s strongest sword.
"Saint Origin Sword Art."

The moment the name appeared, Dragonheart’s aura became terrifyingly complete. The Emotion Severing Path alone was a forbidden edge, a path that could cut emotion, connection, intent, rhythm, certainty, authority, and even the invisible foundation behind techniques.
But with the Saint Origin Sword Art guiding it, that forbidden edge gained origin, structure, and perfect sword order. The severing force no longer spread outward like a cold mist.
It gathered into a single pure line along Dragonheart’s blade, refined until every fragment of power knew exactly what it had to cut.

Max’s right hand held Dragonheart, and his left hand rested near the hilt. His dragon-scaled body sank slightly as the seven-colored lightning gathered above the blade, and the Emotion Severing Path condensed inside the sword edge while the Saint Origin Sword Art gave form to it all.
Across the Divine Realm, countless experts stood up.
"This pressure."
"The Eternal Hourglass is reacting."
"Both attacks are beyond what the stage expected from the younger generation."

The golden laws around the arena became blinding, and for the first time, the Eternal Hourglass trembled faintly. It was not a violent shake. It was small, almost unnoticeable to ordinary spectators, but every true expert sensed it.
The Eternal Hourglass, the supreme venue that had casually contained the battles of the greatest geniuses of this era, had trembled because of the attacks gathering on the stage.
Ervin saw it. Max saw it. Neither stopped.
Ervin stepped forward first. His body almost broke from the movement, but the spear in his hand descended with him.
"Body-Burying Abyss Spear."

The spear thrust out, and the world before Ervin sank. The stage, air, space, lightning, sword aura, and even the golden laws around the impact point seemed to bend downward toward a final depth. The black line of the spear carried the weight of a buried world, rushing toward Max with a power that could have ended nearly any other genius in the conference.
Max stepped forward at the same time. His dragon scales flashed, and the 5000 Dragon Essences roared. Divine King Punishment descended into Dragonheart, and his sword came down.
"Saint Origin Sword Art."
His eyes were calm.
"Emotion Severing Sword."

The slash appeared. It was not large at first. It was a single sword line, cold, bright, and terrifyingly quiet, wrapped in seven-colored lightning and carried by the raw physical force of Max’s dragon-scaled body. But the moment it moved, everything in its path began to separate.

The sinking pressure in front of Ervin was cut. The abyssal line connected to the final depth was cut. The buried-world force wrapped around the spear was cut, and the connection between Ervin’s broken gate and the forbidden spear was cut.

The sword did not merely collide with the Body-Burying Abyss Spear. It severed the things that allowed that spear to become the strongest attack of Ervin’s life. The Saint Origin Sword Art guided Max’s Emotion Severing Path with ruthless precision, while the seven-colored lightning punished each severed layer before the abyss could reform it.
The full physical power of the 5000 Dragon Essences and Dragon Scales Transformation drove the blade forward like an unstoppable dragon descending with divine judgment.

The Body-Burying Abyss Spear trembled. Ervin’s pupils contracted. For a brief moment, his strongest attack pushed back. The abyss roared from beyond the broken gate, and the black line of the spear tried to drag Max’s sword slash into the final depth.
But Max’s slash only became brighter. The Eternal Hourglass trembled again, and golden laws burst around the arena like chains trying to hold the battlefield together.
Then the forbidden spear split.
Crack!
The sound was not loud, but it echoed across the entire Divine Realm. The black line of abyssal depth was cut apart from the center.

The Body-Burying Abyss Spear collapsed layer by layer, its buried-world pressure severed, its final-depth connection broken, and its forbidden authority shattered beneath the combined power of Max’s dragon-strengthened body, Divine King Punishment, Emotion Severing Path, and Saint Origin Sword Art.
Ervin’s black spear broke in his hands. The broken gate behind him cracked, and the black sea dropped as if its source had been severed.

Max’s sword slash continued forward. It did not stop after cutting the attack. It passed through the remains of the abyss, through the shattered shadow of the gate, through the last defense Ervin raised with his broken spear shaft, and stopped only when Dragonheart’s edge reached the side of Ervin’s neck.
The arena became silent. Ervin stood frozen, blood pouring from the cracks across his body. His forbidden art had nearly destroyed him.

His strongest attack had been severed. His spear had broken. And Max stood before him in full Dragon Scales Transformation, seven-colored lightning fading around Dragonheart, his white hair moving gently behind him and his eyes calm.
For several breaths, neither spoke. Then Ervin looked at the broken spear in his hands. After a moment, he gave a soft laugh.
"So even this attack of mine got severed."
Max lowered Dragonheart slightly, but the blade remained close enough to end the battle if Ervin tried to continue.
"It was a good attack."
Ervin smiled faintly, blood staining his lips. "It was my best."
"I know."

Ervin’s knees finally weakened. Before he could collapse, the golden laws of the Eternal Hourglass wrapped around his body to keep his injuries from worsening further. He looked at Max one last time, still smiling faintly despite his ruined state.
"Then I lose."
Angelina Valerius raised her hand. Her voice spread across the silent arena.
[Winner: Max Morgan.]
[Ervin Defeated.]
For one breath, the entire Divine Realm remained completely still. Then the final result screen began to shine.
